34e2d064d03382d71d655fca4221f76e84fdf2a2.title: System Description
34e2d064d03382d71d655fca4221f76e84fdf2a2.description: The cloud provider shall provide a comprehensive system description that outlines the architecture, components, and operational characteristics of the cloud service to ensure transparency for customers.
34e2d064d03382d71d655fca4221f76e84fdf2a2.remediation: Ensure complete system description is documented and maintained.
34e2d064d03382d71d655fca4221f76e84fdf2a2.evidence_required: System description documentation

34e2d064d03382d71d655fca4221f76e84fdf2a2.title: Jurisdiction and Data Storage, Processing and Backup Locations
34e2d064d03382d71d655fca4221f76e84fdf2a2.description: The cloud provider shall disclose all jurisdictions and physical locations where customer data is stored, processed, and backed up to ensure compliance with data residency requirements.
34e2d064d03382d71d655fca4221f76e84fdf2a2.remediation: Document and disclose all data processing locations.
34e2d064d03382d71d655fca4221f76e84fdf2a2.evidence_required: Data location inventory and jurisdiction documentation

34e2d064d03382d71d655fca4221f76e84fdf2a2.title: Disclosure and Investigatory Powers
34e2d064d03382d71d655fca4221f76e84fdf2a2.description: The cloud provider shall disclose applicable legal frameworks, disclosure requirements, and investigatory powers that may affect customer data, including government access requests and mandatory disclosure laws.
34e2d064d03382d71d655fca4221f76e84fdf2a2.remediation: Maintain transparency on legal disclosure requirements.
34e2d064d03382d71d655fca4221f76e84fdf2a2.evidence_required: Legal disclosure policy and jurisdiction analysis

34e2d064d03382d71d655fca4221f76e84fdf2a2.title: Certifications
34e2d064d03382d71d655fca4221f76e84fdf2a2.description: The cloud provider shall maintain and disclose all relevant certifications, attestations, and independent audit reports that demonstrate compliance with security standards and industry best practices.
34e2d064d03382d71d655fca4221f76e84fdf2a2.remediation: Obtain and maintain required certifications.
34e2d064d03382d71d655fca4221f76e84fdf2a2.evidence_required: Certification documents and audit reports

34e2d064d03382d71d655fca4221f76e84fdf2a2.title: Information Security Management System (ISMS)
34e2d064d03382d71d655fca4221f76e84fdf2a2.description: The cloud provider shall implement and maintain a documented Information Security Management System (ISMS) that defines security policies, procedures, and controls to protect information assets in accordance with established security objectives.
34e2d064d03382d71d655fca4221f76e84fdf2a2.remediation: Implement and maintain ISMS documentation and certification.
34e2d064d03382d71d655fca4221f76e84fdf2a2.evidence_required: ISMS documentation, policies, and certification

34e2d064d03382d71d655fca4221f76e84fdf2a2.title: Strategic Targets Regarding Information Security and Responsibility of the Top Management
34e2d064d03382d71d655fca4221f76e84fdf2a2.description: The cloud provider shall define strategic information security targets and ensure top management takes responsibility for information security, including the allocation of resources and commitment to security objectives.
34e2d064d03382d71d655fca4221f76e84fdf2a2.remediation: Establish strategic security targets and management accountability.
34e2d064d03382d71d655fca4221f76e84fdf2a2.evidence_required: Strategic security documentation and management commitment records

34e2d064d03382d71d655fca4221f76e84fdf2a2.title: Authorities and Responsibilities in Information Security
34e2d064d03382d71d655fca4221f76e84fdf2a2.description: The organization defines and documents clear authorities and responsibilities for information security within the organization to ensure accountability and effective governance of security measures.
34e2d064d03382d71d655fca4221f76e84fdf2a2.remediation: Define and document information security roles and responsibilities across the organization.
34e2d064d03382d71d655fca4221f76e84fdf2a2.evidence_required: Organizational chart with security roles and responsibility documentation

34e2d064d03382d71d655fca4221f76e84fdf2a2.title: Separation of Functions
34e2d064d03382d71d655fca4221f76e84fdf2a2.description: The organization ensures appropriate separation of duties is implemented to prevent single individuals from having excessive control over critical processes that could lead to fraud or error.
34e2d064d03382d71d655fca4221f76e84fdf2a2.remediation: Review and implement separation of duties for critical business processes.
34e2d064d03382d71d655fca4221f76e84fdf2a2.evidence_required: Segregation of duties matrix and role definitions

34e2d064d03382d71d655fca4221f76e84fdf2a2.title: Contact with Relevant Government Agencies and Interest Groups
34e2d064d03382d71d655fca4221f76e84fdf2a2.description: The organization maintains appropriate contact with relevant government agencies, regulatory bodies, and industry interest groups to stay informed about security threats, legal requirements, and best practices.
34e2d064d03382d71d655fca4221f76e84fdf2a2.remediation: Establish and maintain contacts with relevant authorities and industry groups.
34e2d064d03382d71d655fca4221f76e84fdf2a2.evidence_required: Contact registry and communication records with authorities

34e2d064d03382d71d655fca4221f76e84fdf2a2.title: Policy for Organization of Risk Management
34e2d064d03382d71d655fca4221f76e84fdf2a2.description: The organization establishes and documents a policy for the organization of risk management that defines the approach, methods, and responsibilities for identifying, analyzing, and handling information security risks.
34e2d064d03382d71d655fca4221f76e84fdf2a2.remediation: Develop and approve a formal risk management policy.
34e2d064d03382d71d655fca4221f76e84fdf2a2.evidence_required: Risk management policy document

34e2d064d03382d71d655fca4221f76e84fdf2a2.title: Identification, Analysis, Assessment and Handling of Risks
34e2d064d03382d71d655fca4221f76e84fdf2a2.description: The organization systematically identifies, analyzes, assesses, and handles information security risks to ensure appropriate mitigation measures are implemented in accordance with the risk management policy.
34e2d064d03382d71d655fca4221f76e84fdf2a2.remediation: Conduct regular risk assessments and maintain an up-to-date risk register.
34e2d064d03382d71d655fca4221f76e84fdf2a2.evidence_required: Risk register and risk assessment reports

34e2d064d03382d71d655fca4221f76e84fdf2a2.title: Documentation, Communication and Provision of Policies and Instructions
34e2d064d03382d71d655fca4221f76e84fdf2a2.description: The organization documents, communicates, and makes available all information security policies and work instructions to relevant personnel in a timely and accessible manner.
34e2d064d03382d71d655fca4221f76e84fdf2a2.remediation: Ensure all policies and instructions are documented and communicated to staff.
34e2d064d03382d71d655fca4221f76e84fdf2a2.evidence_required: Policy distribution records and acknowledgment receipts

34e2d064d03382d71d655fca4221f76e84fdf2a2.title: Review and Approval of Policies and Instructions
34e2d064d03382d71d655fca4221f76e84fdf2a2.description: The organization ensures that all information security policies and work instructions are reviewed and approved by appropriate management before issuance and are subject to periodic review.
34e2d064d03382d71d655fca4221f76e84fdf2a2.remediation: Implement a policy review and approval process with defined review cycles.
34e2d064d03382d71d655fca4221f76e84fdf2a2.evidence_required: Policy approval records and review schedules

34e2d064d03382d71d655fca4221f76e84fdf2a2.title: Deviations from Existing Policies and Instructions
34e2d064d03382d71d655fca4221f76e84fdf2a2.description: The organization defines and documents procedures for handling deviations from established policies and instructions, including approval requirements and documentation of exceptions.
34e2d064d03382d71d655fca4221f76e84fdf2a2.remediation: Establish a formal exception request and approval process.
34e2d064d03382d71d655fca4221f76e84fdf2a2.evidence_required: Exception request logs and approval documentation

34e2d064d03382d71d655fca4221f76e84fdf2a2.title: Security Check of Background Information
34e2d064d03382d71d655fca4221f76e84fdf2a2.description: The organization conducts appropriate security checks on prospective employees, including verification of identity, employment history, education, and criminal background checks where permitted by law.
34e2d064d03382d71d655fca4221f76e84fdf2a2.remediation: Implement background verification procedures for all new hires.
34e2d064d03382d71d655fca4221f76e84fdf2a2.evidence_required: Background check records and verification reports

34e2d064d03382d71d655fca4221f76e84fdf2a2.title: Employment Agreements
34e2d064d03382d71d655fca4221f76e84fdf2a2.description: The organization ensures that employment agreements include appropriate clauses regarding information security obligations, confidentiality requirements, and acceptable use policies.
34e2d064d03382d71d655fca4221f76e84fdf2a2.remediation: Include security and confidentiality clauses in all employment contracts.
34e2d064d03382d71d655fca4221f76e84fdf2a2.evidence_required: Employment contracts with security provisions

34e2d064d03382d71d655fca4221f76e84fdf2a2.title: Security Training and Awareness Programme
34e2d064d03382d71d655fca4221f76e84fdf2a2.description: The organization implements a comprehensive security training and awareness programme to ensure all employees understand their information security responsibilities and are aware of current threats and best practices.
34e2d064d03382d71d655fca4221f76e84fdf2a2.remediation: Implement mandatory security awareness training for all personnel.
34e2d064d03382d71d655fca4221f76e84fdf2a2.evidence_required: Training records and awareness programme materials

34e2d064d03382d71d655fca4221f76e84fdf2a2.title: Disciplinary Measures
34e2d064d03382d71d655fca4221f76e84fdf2a2.description: The organization defines and communicates disciplinary measures for violations of information security policies and procedures to ensure consistent enforcement and deterrence of security breaches.
34e2d064d03382d71d655fca4221f76e84fdf2a2.remediation: Develop and communicate disciplinary policies for security violations.
34e2d064d03382d71d655fca4221f76e84fdf2a2.evidence_required: Disciplinary policy document and enforcement records

34e2d064d03382d71d655fca4221f76e84fdf2a2.title: Termination of Employment Relationship or Changes to Responsibilities
34e2d064d03382d71d655fca4221f76e84fdf2a2.description: The organization implements procedures for the secure termination of employment or changes in responsibilities, including revocation of access rights, return of assets, and completion of exit interviews.
34e2d064d03382d71d655fca4221f76e84fdf2a2.remediation: Implement formal termination procedures including access revocation and asset return.
34e2d064d03382d71d655fca4221f76e84fdf2a2.evidence_required: Termination checklists and access revocation records

34e2d064d03382d71d655fca4221f76e84fdf2a2.title: Asset Inventory
34e2d064d03382d71d655fca4221f76e84fdf2a2.description: The organization maintains a complete and up-to-date inventory of all information system assets, including hardware, software, and data assets, with appropriate classification and ownership.
34e2d064d03382d71d655fca4221f76e84fdf2a2.remediation: Maintain a comprehensive asset inventory with regular updates.
34e2d064d03382d71d655fca4221f76e84fdf2a2.evidence_required: Asset inventory database and inventory reports

34e2d064d03382d71d655fca4221f76e84fdf2a2.title: Assignment of Persons Responsible for Assets
34e2d064d03382d71d655fca4221f76e84fdf2a2.description: The organization assigns clear ownership and responsibility for each asset to ensure accountability for the protection and proper management of all information system assets.
34e2d064d03382d71d655fca4221f76e84fdf2a2.remediation: Assign owners to all assets and document ownership responsibilities.
34e2d064d03382d71d655fca4221f76e84fdf2a2.evidence_required: Asset ownership records and responsibility assignments

34e2d064d03382d71d655fca4221f76e84fdf2a2.title: Instruction Manuals for Assets
34e2d064d03382d71d655fca4221f76e84fdf2a2.description: The organization ensures that appropriate instruction manuals, user guides, and technical documentation are available for all assets to ensure proper and secure operation.
34e2d064d03382d71d655fca4221f76e84fdf2a2.remediation: Maintain and make available documentation for all assets.
34e2d064d03382d71d655fca4221f76e84fdf2a2.evidence_required: Documentation repository and asset manuals

34e2d064d03382d71d655fca4221f76e84fdf2a2.title: Handing In and Returning Assets
34e2d064d03382d71d655fca4221f76e84fdf2a2.description: The organization implements procedures for the proper handover and return of assets, including verification of asset condition and ensuring all access rights are revoked upon return.
34e2d064d03382d71d655fca4221f76e84fdf2a2.remediation: Implement formal asset handover and return procedures.
34e2d064d03382d71d655fca4221f76e84fdf2a2.evidence_required: Asset return records and handover checklists

34e2d064d03382d71d655fca4221f76e84fdf2a2.title: Classification of Information
34e2d064d03382d71d655fca4221f76e84fdf2a2.description: The organization implements an information classification scheme to ensure that information is appropriately protected based on its sensitivity, criticality, and business value.
34e2d064d03382d71d655fca4221f76e84fdf2a2.remediation: Implement and enforce an information classification framework.
34e2d064d03382d71d655fca4221f76e84fdf2a2.evidence_required: Classification policy and classified information inventory

34e2d064d03382d71d655fca4221f76e84fdf2a2.title: Labelling of Information and Handling of Assets
34e2d064d03382d71d655fca4221f76e84fdf2a2.description: The organization implements appropriate labelling of information and assets based on their classification to ensure proper handling, storage, and disposal according to sensitivity levels.
34e2d064d03382d71d655fca4221f76e84fdf2a2.remediation: Implement labelling procedures for all classified information and assets.
34e2d064d03382d71d655fca4221f76e84fdf2a2.evidence_required: Labelling standards and labelled asset records

34e2d064d03382d71d655fca4221f76e84fdf2a2.title: Management of Data Media
34e2d064d03382d71d655fca4221f76e84fdf2a2.description: The organization implements controls for the secure management of data media, including storage, transportation, reuse, and disposal to prevent unauthorized disclosure of information.
34e2d064d03382d71d655fca4221f76e84fdf2a2.remediation: Implement data media management procedures including secure disposal.
34e2d064d03382d71d655fca4221f76e84fdf2a2.evidence_required: Media inventory and disposal certificates

34e2d064d03382d71d655fca4221f76e84fdf2a2.title: Transfer and Removal of Assets
34e2d064d03382d71d655fca4221f76e84fdf2a2.description: The organization implements procedures for the secure transfer and removal of assets, including hardware, software, and data, to prevent unauthorized disclosure or loss of information.
34e2d064d03382d71d655fca4221f76e84fdf2a2.remediation: Implement authorization procedures for asset transfer and removal.
34e2d064d03382d71d655fca4221f76e84fdf2a2.evidence_required: Asset transfer authorization records

34e2d064d03382d71d655fca4221f76e84fdf2a2.title: Perimeter Protection
34e2d064d03382d71d655fca4221f76e84fdf2a2.description: The organization implements physical perimeter security measures, including fences, walls, barriers, or other physical controls to prevent unauthorized access to the facility.
34e2d064d03382d71d655fca4221f76e84fdf2a2.remediation: Implement and maintain physical perimeter security controls.
34e2d064d03382d71d655fca4221f76e84fdf2a2.evidence_required: Perimeter security assessment and implementation records

34e2d064d03382d71d655fca4221f76e84fdf2a2.title: Physical Site Access Control
34e2d064d03382d71d655fca4221f76e84fdf2a2.description: The organization implements physical access controls at site entry points, including access cards, biometric systems, or other authentication mechanisms to control and monitor physical access.
34e2d064d03382d71d655fca4221f76e84fdf2a2.remediation: Implement physical access control systems at all entry points.
34e2d064d03382d71d655fca4221f76e84fdf2a2.evidence_required: Access control system logs and access card records

34e2d064d03382d71d655fca4221f76e84fdf2a2.title: Protection Against Threats from Outside and from the Environment
34e2d064d03382d71d655fca4221f76e84fdf2a2.description: The organization implements measures to protect against environmental threats including natural disasters, extreme weather, fire, flood, and other external threats to infrastructure.
34e2d064d03382d71d655fca4221f76e84fdf2a2.remediation: Implement environmental protection measures and monitoring systems.
34e2d064d03382d71d655fca4221f76e84fdf2a2.evidence_required: Environmental risk assessments and protection measures documentation

34e2d064d03382d71d655fca4221f76e84fdf2a2.title: Protection Against Interruptions Caused by Power Failures and Other Such Risks
34e2d064d03382d71d655fca4221f76e84fdf2a2.description: The organization implements measures to ensure continuity of power supply, including uninterruptible power supplies (UPS), backup generators, and power redundancy to prevent service interruptions.
34e2d064d03382d71d655fca4221f76e84fdf2a2.remediation: Implement power backup systems and test regularly.
34e2d064d03382d71d655fca4221f76e84fdf2a2.evidence_required: Power backup system test records and maintenance logs

34e2d064d03382d71d655fca4221f76e84fdf2a2.title: Maintenance of Infrastructure and Devices
34e2d064d03382d71d655fca4221f76e84fdf2a2.description: The organization implements a scheduled maintenance programme for all physical infrastructure and devices to ensure continued reliable and secure operation.
34e2d064d03382d71d655fca4221f76e84fdf2a2.remediation: Implement and follow a structured maintenance schedule for all infrastructure.
34e2d064d03382d71d655fca4221f76e84fdf2a2.evidence_required: Maintenance schedules and completion records

34e2d064d03382d71d655fca4221f76e84fdf2a2.title: Capacity Management - Planning
34e2d064d03382d71d655fca4221f76e84fdf2a2.description: The organization implements capacity planning to ensure adequate resources are available to meet current and future business requirements, including processing, storage, and network capacity.
34e2d064d03382d71d655fca4221f76e84fdf2a2.remediation: Develop and maintain capacity planning documentation.
34e2d064d03382d71d655fca4221f76e84fdf2a2.evidence_required: Capacity planning documents and resource forecasts

34e2d064d03382d71d655fca4221f76e84fdf2a2.title: Capacity Management - Monitoring
34e2d064d03382d71d655fca4221f76e84fdf2a2.description: The organization continuously monitors resource utilization to ensure optimal performance and to identify potential capacity issues before they impact service delivery.
34e2d064d03382d71d655fca4221f76e84fdf2a2.remediation: Implement resource utilization monitoring and alerting.
34e2d064d03382d71d655fca4221f76e84fdf2a2.evidence_required: Monitoring dashboards and utilization reports

34e2d064d03382d71d655fca4221f76e84fdf2a2.title: Capacity Management - Data Location
34e2d064d03382d71d655fca4221f76e84fdf2a2.description: The organization ensures that data is stored in appropriate locations in accordance with legal, regulatory, and business requirements, including data residency obligations.
34e2d064d03382d71d655fca4221f76e84fdf2a2.remediation: Define and enforce data location policies based on requirements.
34e2d064d03382d71d655fca4221f76e84fdf2a2.evidence_required: Data location inventory and compliance verification

34e2d064d03382d71d655fca4221f76e84fdf2a2.title: Data Backup and Restoration - Regular Tests
34e2d064d03382d71d655fca4221f76e84fdf2a2.description: The cloud provider shall conduct regular tests of data backup and restoration processes to ensure that backups are functional and data can be recovered within defined timeframes.
34e2d064d03382d71d655fca4221f76e84fdf2a2.remediation: Implement and document regular backup restoration tests at least quarterly.
34e2d064d03382d71d655fca4221f76e84fdf2a2.evidence_required: Backup test logs and restoration records

34e2d064d03382d71d655fca4221f76e84fdf2a2.title: Data Backup and Restoration - Storage
34e2d064d03382d71d655fca4221f76e84fdf2a2.description: The cloud provider shall ensure that backup data is stored securely and separately from primary data, with appropriate protection against unauthorized access, loss, and environmental hazards.
34e2d064d03382d71d655fca4221f76e84fdf2a2.remediation: Verify backup storage locations and encryption status.
34e2d064d03382d71d655fca4221f76e84fdf2a2.evidence_required: Backup storage configuration and encryption documentation

34e2d064d03382d71d655fca4221f76e84fdf2a2.title: Logging and Monitoring - Concept
34e2d064d03382d71d655fca4221f76e84fdf2a2.description: The cloud provider shall define and implement a comprehensive logging and monitoring concept that covers all relevant systems, applications, and security-relevant events.
34e2d064d03382d71d655fca4221f76e84fdf2a2.remediation: Develop and approve a formal logging and monitoring concept document.
34e2d064d03382d71d655fca4221f76e84fdf2a2.evidence_required: Logging and monitoring concept documentation

34e2d064d03382d71d655fca4221f76e84fdf2a2.title: Logging and Monitoring - Meta Data
34e2d064d03382d71d655fca4221f76e84fdf2a2.description: The cloud provider shall ensure that log entries contain sufficient meta data, including timestamps, source and destination identifiers, user identifiers, and event types, to enable effective analysis and tracing.
34e2d064d03382d71d655fca4221f76e84fdf2a2.remediation: Review log configurations to ensure all required meta data fields are captured.
34e2d064d03382d71d655fca4221f76e84fdf2a2.evidence_required: Sample log entries showing meta data completeness

34e2d064d03382d71d655fca4221f76e84fdf2a2.title: Logging and Monitoring - Critical Assets
34e2d064d03382d71d655fca4221f76e84fdf2a2.description: The cloud provider shall ensure that critical assets, including sensitive systems and data repositories, are subject to enhanced logging and monitoring to detect and respond to security incidents.
34e2d064d03382d71d655fca4221f76e84fdf2a2.remediation: Identify and document critical assets with enhanced monitoring applied.
34e2d064d03382d71d655fca4221f76e84fdf2a2.evidence_required: Critical asset inventory and monitoring configuration

34e2d064d03382d71d655fca4221f76e84fdf2a2.title: Logging and Monitoring - Storage of the Logs
34e2d064d03382d71d655fca4221f76e84fdf2a2.description: The cloud provider shall implement secure storage for logs that prevents unauthorized modification, deletion, or access, and ensures log retention in accordance with legal and contractual requirements.
34e2d064d03382d71d655fca4221f76e84fdf2a2.remediation: Implement tamper-proof log storage with appropriate retention policies.
34e2d064d03382d71d655fca4221f76e84fdf2a2.evidence_required: Log storage configuration and integrity controls

34e2d064d03382d71d655fca4221f76e84fdf2a2.title: Logging and Monitoring - Accountability
34e2d064d03382d71d655fca4221f76e84fdf2a2.description: The cloud provider shall ensure that log entries can be traced to individual users or processes to establish accountability for actions taken within the cloud environment.
34e2d064d03382d71d655fca4221f76e84fdf2a2.remediation: Enable user attribution in logging systems.
34e2d064d03382d71d655fca4221f76e84fdf2a2.evidence_required: Log analysis showing user attribution capability

34e2d064d03382d71d655fca4221f76e84fdf2a2.title: Logging and Monitoring - Configuration
34e2d064d03382d71d655fca4221f76e84fdf2a2.description: The cloud provider shall ensure that logging and monitoring configurations are properly defined, documented, and maintained to capture relevant security events and support incident investigation.
34e2d064d03382d71d655fca4221f76e84fdf2a2.remediation: Document and maintain logging and monitoring configurations.
34e2d064d03382d71d655fca4221f76e84fdf2a2.evidence_required: Logging configuration documentation

34e2d064d03382d71d655fca4221f76e84fdf2a2.title: Logging and Monitoring - Availability of the Monitoring Software
34e2d064d03382d71d655fca4221f76e84fdf2a2.description: The cloud provider shall ensure that monitoring software and systems remain available and functional, with appropriate redundancy and backup mechanisms to prevent monitoring gaps.
34e2d064d03382d71d655fca4221f76e84fdf2a2.remediation: Implement high availability for monitoring systems.
34e2d064d03382d71d655fca4221f76e84fdf2a2.evidence_required: Monitoring system availability reports

34e2d064d03382d71d655fca4221f76e84fdf2a2.title: Handling of Vulnerabilities, Malfunctions and Errors - Concept
34e2d064d03382d71d655fca4221f76e84fdf2a2.description: The cloud provider shall define and implement a concept for handling vulnerabilities, malfunctions, and errors that includes processes for identification, assessment, remediation, and communication.
34e2d064d03382d71d655fca4221f76e84fdf2a2.remediation: Develop and implement a vulnerability management concept.
34e2d064d03382d71d655fca4221f76e84fdf2a2.evidence_required: Vulnerability management concept documentation

34e2d064d03382d71d655fca4221f76e84fdf2a2.title: Handling of Vulnerabilities, Malfunctions and Errors - Penetration Tests
34e2d064d03382d71d655fca4221f76e84fdf2a2.description: The cloud provider shall conduct regular penetration tests by qualified personnel to identify vulnerabilities and assess the effectiveness of security controls.
34e2d064d03382d71d655fca4221f76e84fdf2a2.remediation: Schedule and conduct regular penetration tests.
34e2d064d03382d71d655fca4221f76e84fdf2a2.evidence_required: Penetration test reports and remediation evidence

34e2d064d03382d71d655fca4221f76e84fdf2a2.title: Handling of Vulnerabilities - Integration with Change and Incident Management
34e2d064d03382d71d655fca4221f76e84fdf2a2.description: The cloud provider shall integrate vulnerability handling processes with change management and incident management to ensure coordinated response and remediation.
34e2d064d03382d71d655fca4221f76e84fdf2a2.remediation: Integrate vulnerability management with change and incident management processes.
34e2d064d03382d71d655fca4221f76e84fdf2a2.evidence_required: Process integration documentation

34e2d064d03382d71d655fca4221f76e84fdf2a2.title: Handling of Vulnerabilities - Involvement of the Cloud Customer
34e2d064d03382d71d655fca4221f76e84fdf2a2.description: The cloud provider shall define processes for involving cloud customers in vulnerability handling, including notification of relevant vulnerabilities and coordination of remediation activities.
34e2d064d03382d71d655fca4221f76e84fdf2a2.remediation: Define and implement customer notification process for vulnerabilities.
34e2d064d03382d71d655fca4221f76e84fdf2a2.evidence_required: Customer notification procedures and records

34e2d064d03382d71d655fca4221f76e84fdf2a2.title: Handling of Vulnerabilities - Check of Open Vulnerabilities
34e2d064d03382d71d655fca4221f76e84fdf2a2.description: The cloud provider shall regularly check for open vulnerabilities in systems and applications, and ensure timely remediation based on risk assessment and severity levels.
34e2d064d03382d71d655fca4221f76e84fdf2a2.remediation: Implement regular vulnerability scanning and remediation tracking.
34e2d064d03382d71d655fca4221f76e84fdf2a2.evidence_required: Vulnerability scan reports and remediation tracking

34e2d064d03382d71d655fca4221f76e84fdf2a2.title: Handling of Vulnerabilities - System Hardening
34e2d064d03382d71d655fca4221f76e84fdf2a2.description: The cloud provider shall implement system hardening measures, including secure configuration, removal of unnecessary services and software, and application of security patches.
34e2d064d03382d71d655fca4221f76e84fdf2a2.remediation: Implement and verify system hardening according to established standards.
34e2d064d03382d71d655fca4221f76e84fdf2a2.evidence_required: Hardening configuration baselines and compliance reports

34e2d064d03382d71d655fca4221f76e84fdf2a2.title: Segregation of Stored and Processed Data of Cloud Customers
34e2d064d03382d71d655fca4221f76e84fdf2a2.description: The cloud provider shall ensure proper segregation of stored and processed data of different cloud customers in jointly used resources to prevent unauthorized access or data leakage between customers.
34e2d064d03382d71d655fca4221f76e84fdf2a2.remediation: Implement and verify data segregation controls for multi-tenant environments.
34e2d064d03382d71d655fca4221f76e84fdf2a2.evidence_required: Data segregation architecture and validation reports

34e2d064d03382d71d655fca4221f76e84fdf2a2.title: Policy for System and Data Access Authorisations
34e2d064d03382d71d655fca4221f76e84fdf2a2.description: The cloud provider shall define and document a policy for system and data access authorizations that establishes principles for granting, reviewing, and revoking access rights.
34e2d064d03382d71d655fca4221f76e84fdf2a2.remediation: Develop and approve an access authorization policy.
34e2d064d03382d71d655fca4221f76e84fdf2a2.evidence_required: Access authorization policy document

34e2d064d03382d71d655fca4221f76e84fdf2a2.title: User Registration
34e2d064d03382d71d655fca4221f76e84fdf2a2.description: The cloud provider shall implement a formal user registration process that verifies the identity of users before granting access to systems and data.
34e2d064d03382d71d655fca4221f76e84fdf2a2.remediation: Implement formal user registration with identity verification.
34e2d064d03382d71d655fca4221f76e84fdf2a2.evidence_required: User registration procedures and records

34e2d064d03382d71d655fca4221f76e84fdf2a2.title: Granting and Change (Provisioning) of Data Access Authorisations
34e2d064d03382d71d655fca4221f76e84fdf2a2.description: The cloud provider shall implement a formal provisioning process for granting and changing data access authorizations, including approval workflows and role-based access control.
34e2d064d03382d71d655fca4221f76e84fdf2a2.remediation: Implement formal provisioning workflow with approval requirements.
34e2d064d03382d71d655fca4221f76e84fdf2a2.evidence_required: Provisioning workflow documentation and approval records

34e2d064d03382d71d655fca4221f76e84fdf2a2.title: Withdrawal of Authorisations (De-provisioning)
34e2d064d03382d71d655fca4221f76e84fdf2a2.description: The cloud provider shall implement timely de-provisioning of access authorizations when changes occur to employment relationships, including termination, role changes, or transfers.
34e2d064d03382d71d655fca4221f76e84fdf2a2.remediation: Implement automated de-provisioning triggered by HR events.
34e2d064d03382d71d655fca4221f76e84fdf2a2.evidence_required: De-provisioning process documentation and timelines

34e2d064d03382d71d655fca4221f76e84fdf2a2.title: Regular Review of Data Access Authorisations
34e2d064d03382d71d655fca4221f76e84fdf2a2.description: The cloud provider shall conduct regular reviews of data access authorizations to ensure that access rights remain appropriate and are revoked when no longer required.
34e2d064d03382d71d655fca4221f76e84fdf2a2.remediation: Implement periodic access rights reviews with documented results.
34e2d064d03382d71d655fca4221f76e84fdf2a2.evidence_required: Access review records and remediation evidence

34e2d064d03382d71d655fca4221f76e84fdf2a2.title: Administrator Authorisations
34e2d064d03382d71d655fca4221f76e84fdf2a2.description: The cloud provider shall implement enhanced controls for administrator authorizations, including limited number of administrators, separation of duties, and privileged access management.
34e2d064d03382d71d655fca4221f76e84fdf2a2.remediation: Implement privileged access management controls for administrators.
34e2d064d03382d71d655fca4221f76e84fdf2a2.evidence_required: Administrator role definitions and privileged access controls

34e2d064d03382d71d655fca4221f76e84fdf2a2.title: Non-disclosure of Authentication Information
34e2d064d03382d71d655fca4221f76e84fdf2a2.description: The cloud provider shall ensure that authentication information, such as passwords and tokens, is not disclosed to unauthorized parties and that users are trained on secure handling of credentials.
34e2d064d03382d71d655fca4221f76e84fdf2a2.remediation: Implement authentication security policy and user training.
34e2d064d03382d71d655fca4221f76e84fdf2a2.evidence_required: Authentication policy and training records

34e2d064d03382d71d655fca4221f76e84fdf2a2.title: Secure Login Methods
34e2d064d03382d71d655fca4221f76e84fdf2a2.description: The cloud provider shall implement secure login methods that include multi-factor authentication, secure protocols, and protection against brute-force and credential stuffing attacks.
34e2d064d03382d71d655fca4221f76e84fdf2a2.remediation: Enable multi-factor authentication and enforce secure login protocols.
34e2d064d03382d71d655fca4221f76e84fdf2a2.evidence_required: Authentication configuration and MFA implementation

34e2d064d03382d71d655fca4221f76e84fdf2a2.title: Handling of Emergency Users
34e2d064d03382d71d655fca4221f76e84fdf2a2.description: The cloud provider shall define and implement processes for emergency users (break-glass accounts) that include appropriate controls, logging, and post-use review.
34e2d064d03382d71d655fca4221f76e84fdf2a2.remediation: Implement emergency access procedures with logging and review.
34e2d064d03382d71d655fca4221f76e84fdf2a2.evidence_required: Emergency access procedures and usage logs

34e2d064d03382d71d655fca4221f76e84fdf2a2.title: System-side Access Control
34e2d064d03382d71d655fca4221f76e84fdf2a2.description: The cloud provider shall implement system-side access controls that enforce authorization rules at the application and database level, not just at the network level.
34e2d064d03382d71d655fca4221f76e84fdf2a2.remediation: Implement application-level and database-level access controls.
34e2d064d03382d71d655fca4221f76e84fdf2a2.evidence_required: System access control configuration and enforcement reports

34e2d064d03382d71d655fca4221f76e84fdf2a2.title: Password Requirements and Validation Parameters
34e2d064d03382d71d655fca4221f76e84fdf2a2.description: The cloud provider shall define and enforce password requirements, including minimum length, complexity, expiration, and prevention of password reuse.
34e2d064d03382d71d655fca4221f76e84fdf2a2.remediation: Implement and enforce password policy compliance.
34e2d064d03382d71d655fca4221f76e84fdf2a2.evidence_required: Password policy documentation and enforcement configuration

34e2d064d03382d71d655fca4221f76e84fdf2a2.title: Restriction and Control of Administrative Software
34e2d064d03382d71d655fca4221f76e84fdf2a2.description: The cloud provider shall restrict and control the use of administrative software and tools to authorized personnel only, with appropriate logging and monitoring of administrative activities.
34e2d064d03382d71d655fca4221f76e84fdf2a2.remediation: Implement controls for administrative software and tools.
34e2d064d03382d71d655fca4221f76e84fdf2a2.evidence_required: Administrative tool control policies and access logs

34e2d064d03382d71d655fca4221f76e84fdf2a2.title: Control of access to source code
34e2d064d03382d71d655fca4221f76e84fdf2a2.description: The cloud provider implements controls to restrict access to source code repositories, ensuring that only authorized personnel can view, modify, or download source code. Access is granted based on the principle of least privilege and requires appropriate authentication and authorization mechanisms.
34e2d064d03382d71d655fca4221f76e84fdf2a2.remediation: Review access logs and enforce role-based access controls for source code repositories.
34e2d064d03382d71d655fca4221f76e84fdf2a2.evidence_required: Access control lists, source code repository logs, authorization records

34e2d064d03382d71d655fca4221f76e84fdf2a2.title: Policy for the use of encryption procedures and key management
34e2d064d03382d71d655fca4221f76e84fdf2a2.description: The cloud provider establishes and maintains a comprehensive policy governing the use of cryptographic procedures and key management. This policy defines encryption standards, key generation, storage, distribution, rotation, and destruction procedures.
34e2d064d03382d71d655fca4221f76e84fdf2a2.remediation: Develop and approve encryption and key management policy documentation.
34e2d064d03382d71d655fca4221f76e84fdf2a2.evidence_required: Encryption policy document, key management procedures

34e2d064d03382d71d655fca4221f76e84fdf2a2.title: Encryption of data for transmission (transport encryption)
34e2d064d03382d71d655fca4221f76e84fdf2a2.description: The cloud provider implements transport layer security mechanisms to encrypt all data transmitted between users, systems, and cloud services. This includes encryption of data in transit over internal and external networks using industry-standard protocols.
34e2d064d03382d71d655fca4221f76e84fdf2a2.remediation: Implement and enforce TLS 1.2 or higher for all data transmissions.
34e2d064d03382d71d655fca4221f76e84fdf2a2.evidence_required: TLS configuration records, certificate management logs

34e2d064d03382d71d655fca4221f76e84fdf2a2.title: Encryption of sensitive data for storage
34e2d064d03382d71d655fca4221f76e84fdf2a2.description: The cloud provider encrypts sensitive data at rest using appropriate cryptographic mechanisms. This includes encryption of customer data, databases, file systems, and backup storage using strong encryption algorithms.
34e2d064d03382d71d655fca4221f76e84fdf2a2.remediation: Enable encryption at rest for all sensitive data storage systems.
34e2d064d03382d71d655fca4221f76e84fdf2a2.evidence_required: Encryption configuration, key management records

34e2d064d03382d71d655fca4221f76e84fdf2a2.title: Secure key management
34e2d064d03382d71d655fca4221f76e84fdf2a2.description: The cloud provider implements secure key management practices including secure generation, storage, distribution, rotation, and destruction of cryptographic keys. Keys are protected against unauthorized access, modification, and disclosure.
34e2d064d03382d71d655fca4221f76e84fdf2a2.remediation: Review key management procedures and ensure keys are stored in secure hardware security modules.
34e2d064d03382d71d655fca4221f76e84fdf2a2.evidence_required: Key management logs, HSM configuration, key rotation records

34e2d064d03382d71d655fca4221f76e84fdf2a2.title: Technical safeguards
34e2d064d03382d71d655fca4221f76e84fdf2a2.description: The cloud provider implements technical safeguards to protect network communications and system interfaces. This includes firewalls, intrusion detection/prevention systems, and other technical controls to secure network perimeters and communication channels.
34e2d064d03382d71d655fca4221f76e84fdf2a2.remediation: Review and update technical safeguard configurations regularly.
34e2d064d03382d71d655fca4221f76e84fdf2a2.evidence_required: Firewall rules, IDS/IPS logs, security configuration baselines

34e2d064d03382d71d655fca4221f76e84fdf2a2.title: Monitoring of connections
34e2d064d03382d71d655fca4221f76e84fdf2a2.description: The cloud provider implements monitoring of all network connections to detect unauthorized access attempts, anomalies, and potential security incidents. This includes logging and analysis of inbound and outbound connections.
34e2d064d03382d71d655fca4221f76e84fdf2a2.remediation: Enable connection monitoring and review logs for suspicious activity.
34e2d064d03382d71d655fca4221f76e84fdf2a2.evidence_required: Connection logs, monitoring dashboards, alert configurations

34e2d064d03382d71d655fca4221f76e84fdf2a2.title: Cross-network access
34e2d064d03382d71d655fca4221f76e84fdf2a2.description: The cloud provider implements controls to manage and restrict cross-network access, ensuring proper segmentation between different network zones. Access between network segments is controlled and monitored based on business requirements.
34e2d064d03382d71d655fca4221f76e84fdf2a2.remediation: Implement network segmentation and review cross-network access rules.
34e2d064d03382d71d655fca4221f76e84fdf2a2.evidence_required: Network architecture diagrams, segmentation rules, access control lists

34e2d064d03382d71d655fca4221f76e84fdf2a2.title: Networks for administration
34e2d064d03382d71d655fca4221f76e84fdf2a2.description: The cloud provider maintains dedicated administrative networks for system management activities. Administrative access is segregated from general user traffic and protected through additional security controls.
34e2d064d03382d71d655fca4221f76e84fdf2a2.remediation: Implement dedicated administrative networks and enforce isolation.
34e2d064d03382d71d655fca4221f76e84fdf2a2.evidence_required: Network architecture documentation, admin network configurations

34e2d064d03382d71d655fca4221f76e84fdf2a2.title: Segregation of data traffic in jointly used network environments
34e2d064d03382d71d655fca4221f76e84fdf2a2.description: The cloud provider implements controls to segregate data traffic in shared or multi-tenant network environments. Customer data traffic is logically or physically separated to prevent unauthorized access or interference between tenants.
34e2d064d03382d71d655fca4221f76e84fdf2a2.remediation: Implement tenant isolation and traffic segregation mechanisms.
34e2d064d03382d71d655fca4221f76e84fdf2a2.evidence_required: Network isolation configurations, tenant segregation documentation

34e2d064d03382d71d655fca4221f76e84fdf2a2.title: Documentation of the network topology
34e2d064d03382d71d655fca4221f76e84fdf2a2.description: The cloud provider maintains current and comprehensive documentation of the network topology, including all network segments, connections, security zones, and infrastructure components.
34e2d064d03382d71d655fca4221f76e84fdf2a2.remediation: Maintain and update network topology documentation regularly.
34e2d064d03382d71d655fca4221f76e84fdf2a2.evidence_required: Network topology diagrams, infrastructure documentation

34e2d064d03382d71d655fca4221f76e84fdf2a2.title: Policies for data transmission
34e2d064d03382d71d655fca4221f76e84fdf2a2.description: The cloud provider establishes and implements policies governing the transmission of data, including acceptable methods, required encryption, and data classification requirements for different transmission scenarios.
34e2d064d03382d71d655fca4221f76e84fdf2a2.remediation: Develop and enforce data transmission policies.
34e2d064d03382d71d655fca4221f76e84fdf2a2.evidence_required: Data transmission policy document, compliance records

34e2d064d03382d71d655fca4221f76e84fdf2a2.title: Confidentiality agreement
34e2d064d03382d71d655fca4221f76e84fdf2a2.description: The cloud provider requires confidentiality agreements from personnel and service providers who have access to sensitive information. These agreements define obligations regarding the protection of confidential data.
34e2d064d03382d71d655fca4221f76e84fdf2a2.remediation: Ensure all personnel and service providers sign confidentiality agreements.
34e2d064d03382d71d655fca4221f76e84fdf2a2.evidence_required: Signed confidentiality agreements, agreement tracking records

34e2d064d03382d71d655fca4221f76e84fdf2a2.title: Use of public APIs and industry standards
34e2d064d03382d71d655fca4221f76e84fdf2a2.description: The cloud provider utilizes industry-standard public APIs and follows established protocols for interoperability. APIs are designed according to common standards to enable integration and data portability.
34e2d064d03382d71d655fca4221f76e84fdf2a2.remediation: Review API implementations for standards compliance.
34e2d064d03382d71d655fca4221f76e84fdf2a2.evidence_required: API documentation, standards compliance assessments

34e2d064d03382d71d655fca4221f76e84fdf2a2.title: Export of data
34e2d064d03382d71d655fca4221f76e84fdf2a2.description: The cloud provider enables customers to export their data in a standard, machine-readable format. Data export capabilities are provided to ensure customers can retrieve their data in a timely manner.
34e2d064d03382d71d655fca4221f76e84fdf2a2.remediation: Verify data export functionality is available and operational.
34e2d064d03382d71d655fca4221f76e84fdf2a2.evidence_required: Data export logs, export functionality testing records

34e2d064d03382d71d655fca4221f76e84fdf2a2.title: Policy for the portability and interoperability
34e2d064d03382d71d655fca4221f76e84fdf2a2.description: The cloud provider establishes and maintains a policy addressing data portability and system interoperability. This policy defines procedures and technical measures to ensure customers can move data and switch service providers.
34e2d064d03382d71d655fca4221f76e84fdf2a2.remediation: Develop and approve portability and interoperability policy.
34e2d064d03382d71d655fca4221f76e84fdf2a2.evidence_required: Portability policy document, interoperability documentation

34e2d064d03382d71d655fca4221f76e84fdf2a2.title: Secure data import and export
34e2d064d03382d71d655fca4221f76e84fdf2a2.description: The cloud provider implements security controls for data import and export operations, ensuring that data transfers are protected against unauthorized access, modification, or interception during the transfer process.
34e2d064d03382d71d655fca4221f76e84fdf2a2.remediation: Implement encryption for all data import and export operations.
34e2d064d03382d71d655fca4221f76e84fdf2a2.evidence_required: Transfer logs, encryption configuration records

34e2d064d03382d71d655fca4221f76e84fdf2a2.title: Secure deletion of data
34e2d064d03382d71d655fca4221f76e84fdf2a2.description: The cloud provider implements secure data deletion procedures to ensure that data is permanently and irreversibly removed when requested or when no longer needed. Deletion methods meet recognized security standards for data destruction.
34e2d064d03382d71d655fca4221f76e84fdf2a2.remediation: Implement certified secure deletion methods for all data removal.
34e2d064d03382d71d655fca4221f76e84fdf2a2.evidence_required: Data deletion logs, destruction certificates, deletion procedure documentation

34e2d064d03382d71d655fca4221f76e84fdf2a2.title: Policies for the development/procurement of information systems
34e2d064d03382d71d655fca4221f76e84fdf2a2.description: The cloud provider establishes policies governing the development and procurement of information systems. These policies define requirements for security, quality assurance, and compliance with regulatory standards.
34e2d064d03382d71d655fca4221f76e84fdf2a2.remediation: Develop and approve development and procurement policies.
34e2d064d03382d71d655fca4221f76e84fdf2a2.evidence_required: Development policy, procurement policy documents

34e2d064d03382d71d655fca4221f76e84fdf2a2.title: Outsourcing of the development
34e2d064d03382d71d655fca4221f76e84fdf2a2.description: The cloud provider implements controls when outsourcing development activities to third parties. This includes security requirements, background checks, and contractual obligations to ensure outsourced development meets security standards.
34e2d064d03382d71d655fca4221f76e84fdf2a2.remediation: Review and enforce security controls for outsourced development.
34e2d064d03382d71d655fca4221f76e84fdf2a2.evidence_required: Outsourcing contracts, security requirements documentation, vendor assessments

34e2d064d03382d71d655fca4221f76e84fdf2a2.title: Policies for changes to information systems
34e2d064d03382d71d655fca4221f76e84fdf2a2.description: The cloud provider establishes policies governing changes to information systems, including procedures for requesting, approving, implementing, and documenting changes.
34e2d064d03382d71d655fca4221f76e84fdf2a2.remediation: Develop and approve change management policies.
34e2d064d03382d71d655fca4221f76e84fdf2a2.evidence_required: Change management policy document

34e2d064d03382d71d655fca4221f76e84fdf2a2.title: Risk assessment of changes
34e2d064d03382d71d655fca4221f76e84fdf2a2.description: The cloud provider conducts risk assessments for proposed changes to information systems to identify potential security, operational, and compliance impacts before implementation.
34e2d064d03382d71d655fca4221f76e84fdf2a2.remediation: Ensure risk assessments are completed for all significant changes.
34e2d064d03382d71d655fca4221f76e84fdf2a2.evidence_required: Risk assessment records, change request documentation

34e2d064d03382d71d655fca4221f76e84fdf2a2.title: Categorisation of changes
34e2d064d03382d71d655fca4221f76e84fdf2a2.description: The cloud provider categorizes changes based on their impact, complexity, and risk level. This categorization determines the approval process, testing requirements, and implementation procedures for each change.
34e2d064d03382d71d655fca4221f76e84fdf2a2.remediation: Implement change categorization framework.
34e2d064d03382d71d655fca4221f76e84fdf2a2.evidence_required: Change categorization scheme, categorization records

34e2d064d03382d71d655fca4221f76e84fdf2a2.title: Prioritisation of changes
34e2d064d03382d71d655fca4221f76e84fdf2a2.description: The cloud provider implements prioritization of changes based on business criticality, security impact, and resource requirements. Changes are scheduled and executed according to their assigned priority.
34e2d064d03382d71d655fca4221f76e84fdf2a2.remediation: Implement change prioritization process.
34e2d064d03382d71d655fca4221f76e84fdf2a2.evidence_required: Priority assignment records, change scheduling documentation

34e2d064d03382d71d655fca4221f76e84fdf2a2.title: Testing changes
34e2d064d03382d71d655fca4221f76e84fdf2a2.description: The cloud provider implements comprehensive testing procedures for all changes to information systems. Testing includes functional, security, and performance testing before changes are deployed to production environments.
34e2d064d03382d71d655fca4221f76e84fdf2a2.remediation: Ensure all changes undergo appropriate testing before deployment.
34e2d064d03382d71d655fca4221f76e84fdf2a2.evidence_required: Test plans, test results, testing completion records

34e2d064d03382d71d655fca4221f76e84fdf2a2.title: Rollback of changes
34e2d064d03382d71d655fca4221f76e84fdf2a2.description: The cloud provider implements rollback procedures to enable reversion to previous system states if changes cause issues. Rollback plans are documented and tested to ensure rapid recovery capability.
34e2d064d03382d71d655fca4221f76e84fdf2a2.remediation: Develop and document rollback procedures for all changes.
34e2d064d03382d71d655fca4221f76e84fdf2a2.evidence_required: Rollback plans, rollback testing records

34e2d064d03382d71d655fca4221f76e84fdf2a2.title: Review of proper testing and approval
34e2d064d03382d71d655fca4221f76e84fdf2a2.description: The cloud provider implements a review process to verify that changes have been properly tested and have received appropriate approval before implementation. This includes verification of test coverage and approval workflows.
34e2d064d03382d71d655fca4221f76e84fdf2a2.remediation: Implement test review and approval verification process.
34e2d064d03382d71d655fca4221f76e84fdf2a2.evidence_required: Test review records, approval workflow logs

34e2d064d03382d71d655fca4221f76e84fdf2a2.title: Emergency changes
34e2d064d03382d71d655fca4221f76e84fdf2a2.description: The cloud provider implements procedures for handling emergency changes that require immediate implementation. Emergency change procedures include expedited approval, documentation, and post-implementation review.
34e2d064d03382d71d655fca4221f76e84fdf2a2.remediation: Define and document emergency change procedures.
34e2d064d03382d71d655fca4221f76e84fdf2a2.evidence_required: Emergency change procedures, emergency change records

34e2d064d03382d71d655fca4221f76e84fdf2a2.title: System landscape
34e2d064d03382d71d655fca4221f76e84fdf2a2.description: The cloud provider maintains documentation of the complete system landscape, including all hardware, software, and network components. This documentation is kept current and reflects the actual production environment.
34e2d064d03382d71d655fca4221f76e84fdf2a2.remediation: Maintain current system landscape documentation.
34e2d064d03382d71d655fca4221f76e84fdf2a2.evidence_required: System landscape documentation, inventory records

34e2d064d03382d71d655fca4221f76e84fdf2a2.title: Responsibilities and Procedural Model for Security Incident Management
34e2d064d03382d71d655fca4221f76e84fdf2a2.description: The cloud provider defines clear responsibilities and establishes a procedural model for managing security incidents, including roles, escalation paths, and communication procedures.
34e2d064d03382d71d655fca4221f76e84fdf2a2.remediation: Define and document incident management roles and procedures.
34e2d064d03382d71d655fca4221f76e84fdf2a2.evidence_required: Incident management policy and organizational chart

34e2d064d03382d71d655fca4221f76e84fdf2a2.title: Classification of Customer Systems
34e2d064d03382d71d655fca4221f76e84fdf2a2.description: The cloud provider implements a classification system for customer systems to determine appropriate security incident handling procedures based on criticality and sensitivity.
34e2d064d03382d71d655fca4221f76e84fdf2a2.remediation: Implement and maintain a system classification framework.
34e2d064d03382d71d655fca4221f76e84fdf2a2.evidence_required: System classification documentation

34e2d064d03382d71d655fca4221f76e84fdf2a2.title: Processing of Security Incidents
34e2d064d03382d71d655fca4221f76e84fdf2a2.description: The cloud provider establishes procedures for processing security incidents, including detection, analysis, containment, eradication, and recovery steps.
34e2d064d03382d71d655fca4221f76e84fdf2a2.remediation: Review and enhance incident processing procedures.
34e2d064d03382d71d655fca4221f76e84fdf2a2.evidence_required: Incident handling procedures and logs

34e2d064d03382d71d655fca4221f76e84fdf2a2.title: Documentation and Reporting of Security Incidents
34e2d064d03382d71d655fca4221f76e84fdf2a2.description: The cloud provider maintains comprehensive documentation of all security incidents and provides timely reporting to relevant stakeholders and customers as required.
34e2d064d03382d71d655fca4221f76e84fdf2a2.remediation: Ensure complete incident documentation and reporting.
34e2d064d03382d71d655fca4221f76e84fdf2a2.evidence_required: Incident reports and documentation records

34e2d064d03382d71d655fca4221f76e84fdf2a2.title: Security Incident Event Management
34e2d064d03382d71d655fca4221f76e84fdf2a2.description: The cloud provider implements security incident event management capabilities to collect, correlate, and analyze security events from various sources.
34e2d064d03382d71d655fca4221f76e84fdf2a2.remediation: Implement or enhance security event management capabilities.
34e2d064d03382d71d655fca4221f76e84fdf2a2.evidence_required: SIEM configuration and event logs

34e2d064d03382d71d655fca4221f76e84fdf2a2.title: User Reporting Obligation for Security Incidents
34e2d064d03382d71d655fca4221f76e84fdf2a2.description: The cloud provider establishes obligations for users to report security incidents to a central body within the organization.
34e2d064d03382d71d655fca4221f76e84fdf2a2.remediation: Communicate reporting obligations to all users.
34e2d064d03382d71d655fca4221f76e84fdf2a2.evidence_required: Security awareness training materials

34e2d064d03382d71d655fca4221f76e84fdf2a2.title: Evaluation and Learning Process for Security Incidents
34e2d064d03382d71d655fca4221f76e84fdf2a2.description: The cloud provider implements processes to evaluate security incidents, identify root causes, and implement improvements to prevent recurrence.
34e2d064d03382d71d655fca4221f76e84fdf2a2.remediation: Conduct post-incident reviews and implement improvements.
34e2d064d03382d71d655fca4221f76e84fdf2a2.evidence_required: Post-incident review reports

34e2d064d03382d71d655fca4221f76e84fdf2a2.title: Top Management Responsibility for Business Continuity
34e2d064d03382d71d655fca4221f76e84fdf2a2.description: Top management of the cloud provider takes responsibility for business continuity management, including defining strategy, allocating resources, and ensuring organizational commitment.
34e2d064d03382d71d655fca4221f76e84fdf2a2.remediation: Obtain formal commitment from top management.
34e2d064d03382d71d655fca4221f76e84fdf2a2.evidence_required: Management commitment documentation

34e2d064d03382d71d655fca4221f76e84fdf2a2.title: Business Impact Analysis Policies and Procedures
34e2d064d03382d71d655fca4221f76e84fdf2a2.description: The cloud provider establishes policies and procedures for conducting business impact analysis to identify critical business functions and their recovery requirements.
34e2d064d03382d71d655fca4221f76e84fdf2a2.remediation: Conduct business impact analysis and document results.
34e2d064d03382d71d655fca4221f76e84fdf2a2.evidence_required: BIA documentation and analysis reports

34e2d064d03382d71d655fca4221f76e84fdf2a2.title: Business Continuity Planning
34e2d064d03382d71d655fca4221f76e84fdf2a2.description: The cloud provider develops and maintains business continuity plans to ensure the continued delivery of critical services during and after a disruption.
34e2d064d03382d71d655fca4221f76e84fdf2a2.remediation: Develop and maintain business continuity plans.
34e2d064d03382d71d655fca4221f76e84fdf2a2.evidence_required: Business continuity plans

34e2d064d03382d71d655fca4221f76e84fdf2a2.title: Verification, Updating and Testing of Business Continuity
34e2d064d03382d71d655fca4221f76e84fdf2a2.description: The cloud provider regularly verifies, updates, and tests business continuity plans to ensure their effectiveness and relevance.
34e2d064d03382d71d655fca4221f76e84fdf2a2.remediation: Schedule and conduct regular BC plan tests.
34e2d064d03382d71d655fca4221f76e84fdf2a2.evidence_required: BC test records and update logs

34e2d064d03382d71d655fca4221f76e84fdf2a2.title: Supply of Computing Centres
34e2d064d03382d71d655fca4221f76e84fdf2a2.description: The cloud provider ensures the reliable supply of computing centres, including power, cooling, and connectivity, to support business continuity requirements.
34e2d064d03382d71d655fca4221f76e84fdf2a2.remediation: Review and enhance data centre infrastructure resilience.
34e2d064d03382d71d655fca4221f76e84fdf2a2.evidence_required: Data centre specifications and supply agreements

34e2d064d03382d71d655fca4221f76e84fdf2a2.title: Notification of Top Management
34e2d064d03382d71d655fca4221f76e84fdf2a2.description: The cloud provider ensures that top management is notified of significant security issues and audit findings in a timely manner.
34e2d064d03382d71d655fca4221f76e84fdf2a2.remediation: Establish management notification procedures.
34e2d064d03382d71d655fca4221f76e84fdf2a2.evidence_required: Notification records

34e2d064d03382d71d655fca4221f76e84fdf2a2.title: Internal Audits of IT Process Compliance
34e2d064d03382d71d655fca4221f76e84fdf2a2.description: The cloud provider conducts internal audits to verify compliance of IT processes with internal security policies and standards.
34e2d064d03382d71d655fca4221f76e84fdf2a2.remediation: Schedule and conduct internal IT process audits.
34e2d064d03382d71d655fca4221f76e84fdf2a2.evidence_required: Internal audit reports

34e2d064d03382d71d655fca4221f76e84fdf2a2.title: Internal Audits of IT System Compliance
34e2d064d03382d71d655fca4221f76e84fdf2a2.description: The cloud provider conducts internal audits to verify compliance of IT systems with internal security policies and standards.
34e2d064d03382d71d655fca4221f76e84fdf2a2.remediation: Schedule and conduct internal IT system audits.
34e2d064d03382d71d655fca4221f76e84fdf2a2.evidence_required: Internal audit reports

34e2d064d03382d71d655fca4221f76e84fdf2a2.title: Identification of Applicable Requirements
34e2d064d03382d71d655fca4221f76e84fdf2a2.description: The cloud provider identifies and documents all applicable legal, contractual, and data protection requirements relevant to its operations and customer data.
34e2d064d03382d71d655fca4221f76e84fdf2a2.remediation: Maintain comprehensive requirements register.
34e2d064d03382d71d655fca4221f76e84fdf2a2.evidence_required: Requirements documentation

34e2d064d03382d71d655fca4221f76e84fdf2a2.title: Planning Independent External Audits
34e2d064d03382d71d655fca4221f76e84fdf2a2.description: The cloud provider plans independent external audits to verify compliance with applicable requirements and standards.
34e2d064d03382d71d655fca4221f76e84fdf2a2.remediation: Develop and maintain external audit plan.
34e2d064d03382d71d655fca4221f76e84fdf2a2.evidence_required: External audit plan

34e2d064d03382d71d655fca4221f76e84fdf2a2.title: Carrying Out Independent External Audits
34e2d064d03382d71d655fca4221f76e84fdf2a2.description: The cloud provider conducts independent external audits in accordance with the planned schedule and reports findings to relevant stakeholders.
34e2d064d03382d71d655fca4221f76e84fdf2a2.remediation: Conduct external audits as planned.
34e2d064d03382d71d655fca4221f76e84fdf2a2.evidence_required: External audit reports

34e2d064d03382d71d655fca4221f76e84fdf2a2.title: Mobile Device Management Policies and Procedures
34e2d064d03382d71d655fca4221f76e84fdf2a2.description: The cloud provider establishes policies and procedures to minimize risks associated with access via mobile terminal devices owned or managed by the cloud provider.
34e2d064d03382d71d655fca4221f76e84fdf2a2.remediation: Develop and implement mobile device management policies.
34e2d064d03382d71d655fca4221f76e84fdf2a2.evidence_required: Mobile device management policy

34e2d064d03382d71d655fca4221f76e84fdf2a2.title: Standard-Based Requirements
34e2d064d03382d71d655fca4221f76e84fdf2a2.description: Requirements shall, wherever possible, be taken from known security standards and specified if necessary. They shall be supplemented by BSI's own requirements only to the extent needed.
34e2d064d03382d71d655fca4221f76e84fdf2a2.remediation: Review requirements to ensure they are traceable to known security standards.
34e2d064d03382d71d655fca4221f76e84fdf2a2.evidence_required: Mapping document linking requirements to known security standards

34e2d064d03382d71d655fca4221f76e84fdf2a2.title: Transparent Documentation of Requirements Origin
34e2d064d03382d71d655fca4221f76e84fdf2a2.description: The origin of requirements shall be documented in a transparent manner so that the cloud provider is able to easily perform a comparison with their own security level.
34e2d064d03382d71d655fca4221f76e84fdf2a2.remediation: Ensure all requirements have documented origin and traceability.
34e2d064d03382d71d655fca4221f76e84fdf2a2.evidence_required: Requirement origin documentation and mapping

34e2d064d03382d71d655fca4221f76e84fdf2a2.title: Basic Requirements for Secure Cloud Computing
34e2d064d03382d71d655fca4221f76e84fdf2a2.description: The basic requirements shall always be met for secure cloud computing. Additional requirements may be included for certain basic requirements where considered appropriate by BSI.
34e2d064d03382d71d655fca4221f76e84fdf2a2.remediation: Ensure all basic requirements are met before claiming C5 compliance.
34e2d064d03382d71d655fca4221f76e84fdf2a2.evidence_required: Basic requirements checklist and evidence of fulfillment

34e2d064d03382d71d655fca4221f76e84fdf2a2.title: Customer-Determined Requirement Scope
34e2d064d03382d71d655fca4221f76e84fdf2a2.description: It is up to the cloud customer to decide for their specific use case whether basic requirements are sufficient or additional optional requirements have to be met by the cloud provider.
34e2d064d03382d71d655fca4221f76e84fdf2a2.remediation: Clearly communicate to customers the option to require additional requirements beyond basic level.
34e2d064d03382d71d655fca4221f76e84fdf2a2.evidence_required: Documentation of customer requirement scope decisions

34e2d064d03382d71d655fca4221f76e84fdf2a2.title: Independent Third-Party Audit
34e2d064d03382d71d655fca4221f76e84fdf2a2.description: The cloud customer shall be able to prove that requirements of C5 are fulfilled by means of a transparent audit performed by an independent, trusted third party.
34e2d064d03382d71d655fca4221f76e84fdf2a2.remediation: Engage independent third-party auditor for C5 compliance verification.
34e2d064d03382d71d655fca4221f76e84fdf2a2.evidence_required: Third-party audit report from independent auditor

34e2d064d03382d71d655fca4221f76e84fdf2a2.title: Leverage Existing Standards and Certifications
34e2d064d03382d71d655fca4221f76e84fdf2a2.description: The audit shall build on existing standards and certifications and thus generate the lowest possible additional effort for the cloud provider.
34e2d064d03382d71d655fca4221f76e84fdf2a2.remediation: Identify and leverage existing certifications where applicable.
34e2d064d03382d71d655fca4221f76e84fdf2a2.evidence_required: Evidence of existing certifications and standards mapping

34e2d064d03382d71d655fca4221f76e84fdf2a2.title: International Auditing Standards Compliance
34e2d064d03382d71d655fca4221f76e84fdf2a2.description: The audit shall be performed according to an international auditing standard and shall be suitable for an audit by a certified public auditor.
34e2d064d03382d71d655fca4221f76e84fdf2a2.remediation: Ensure audit follows recognized international auditing standards.
34e2d064d03382d71d655fca4221f76e84fdf2a2.evidence_required: Audit performed according to international auditing standards

34e2d064d03382d71d655fca4221f76e84fdf2a2.title: Organisation of Information Security
34e2d064d03382d71d655fca4221f76e84fdf2a2.description: Planning, implementation, maintenance and continuous improvement of a framework regarding information security within the organisation.
34e2d064d03382d71d655fca4221f76e84fdf2a2.remediation: Establish and maintain an information security management framework with defined roles, responsibilities, and continuous improvement processes.
34e2d064d03382d71d655fca4221f76e84fdf2a2.evidence_required: Information security policies, organizational charts, and security framework documentation

34e2d064d03382d71d655fca4221f76e84fdf2a2.title: Security Policies and Work Instructions
34e2d064d03382d71d655fca4221f76e84fdf2a2.description: Providing policies and instructions with respect to the security claim and to support the business requirements.
34e2d064d03382d71d655fca4221f76e84fdf2a2.remediation: Develop and maintain comprehensive security policies and work instructions aligned with business requirements and security objectives.
34e2d064d03382d71d655fca4221f76e84fdf2a2.evidence_required: Security policy documents, work instructions, and approval records

34e2d064d03382d71d655fca4221f76e84fdf2a2.title: Personnel Security
34e2d064d03382d71d655fca4221f76e84fdf2a2.description: Making sure that employees, service providers and suppliers understand their tasks, are aware of their responsibility with regard to information security and that the assets of the organisation are protected if the tasks are modified or completed.
34e2d064d03382d71d655fca4221f76e84fdf2a2.remediation: Implement personnel security training and awareness programs to ensure employees, service providers, and suppliers understand their information security responsibilities.
34e2d064d03382d71d655fca4221f76e84fdf2a2.evidence_required: Training records, awareness materials, and personnel security agreements

34e2d064d03382d71d655fca4221f76e84fdf2a2.title: Asset Management
34e2d064d03382d71d655fca4221f76e84fdf2a2.description: Identifying the organisation's own assets and responsible persons as well as ensuring an appropriate level of protection.
34e2d064d03382d71d655fca4221f76e84fdf2a2.remediation: Maintain an inventory of all organisation assets and assign ownership to ensure appropriate protection levels are applied.
34e2d064d03382d71d655fca4221f76e84fdf2a2.evidence_required: Asset inventory, asset classification, and ownership records

34e2d064d03382d71d655fca4221f76e84fdf2a2.title: Physical Security
34e2d064d03382d71d655fca4221f76e84fdf2a2.description: Preventing unauthorised physical access and protection against theft, damage, loss and failure of operations.
34e2d064d03382d71d655fca4221f76e84fdf2a2.remediation: Implement physical security controls including access controls, monitoring systems, and protection against environmental threats.
34e2d064d03382d71d655fca4221f76e84fdf2a2.evidence_required: Physical access logs, security perimeter documentation, environmental controls

34e2d064d03382d71d655fca4221f76e84fdf2a2.title: Operations Security
34e2d064d03382d71d655fca4221f76e84fdf2a2.description: Assuring proper regular operations including appropriate safeguards for planning and monitoring the capacity, protection against malware, logging and monitoring events as well as handling vulnerabilities, malfunctions and errors.
34e2d064d03382d71d655fca4221f76e84fdf2a2.remediation: Implement operational security controls including capacity planning, malware protection, event logging, monitoring, and vulnerability management processes.
34e2d064d03382d71d655fca4221f76e84fdf2a2.evidence_required: Operations logs, vulnerability scan reports, incident records, capacity planning documents

34e2d064d03382d71d655fca4221f76e84fdf2a2.title: Identity and Access Management
34e2d064d03382d71d655fca4221f76e84fdf2a2.description: Securing the authorisation and authentication of users of the cloud provider (usually privileged user) and the cloud customer in order to prevent unauthorised access.
34e2d064d03382d71d655fca4221f76e84fdf2a2.remediation: Implement robust identity and access management controls including multi-factor authentication, role-based access control, and regular access reviews.
34e2d064d03382d71d655fca4221f76e84fdf2a2.evidence_required: Access control policies, authentication logs, access review records, privileged access management documentation

34e2d064d03382d71d655fca4221f76e84fdf2a2.title: Cryptography and Key Management
34e2d064d03382d71d655fca4221f76e84fdf2a2.description: Ensuring proper use of cryptographic methods and secure key management to protect data confidentiality and integrity.
34e2d064d03382d71d655fca4221f76e84fdf2a2.remediation: Implement cryptographic controls and key management procedures aligned with data protection requirements and industry standards.
34e2d064d03382d71d655fca4221f76e84fdf2a2.evidence_required: Cryptography policies, key management procedures, encryption implementation documentation

34e2d064d03382d71d655fca4221f76e84fdf2a2.title: Communication Security
34e2d064d03382d71d655fca4221f76e84fdf2a2.description: The cloud provider implements measures for protecting information in networks and the corresponding information-processing systems. This includes securing data in transit, network segmentation, and protection against unauthorized network access.
34e2d064d03382d71d655fca4221f76e84fdf2a2.remediation: Implement network security controls and ensure encrypted communications.
34e2d064d03382d71d655fca4221f76e84fdf2a2.evidence_required: Network architecture documentation and encryption configurations

34e2d064d03382d71d655fca4221f76e84fdf2a2.title: Portability and Interoperability
34e2d064d03382d71d655fca4221f76e84fdf2a2.description: The cloud provider ensures the ability to securely operate the service on different IT platforms as well as the possibility of secure connections to different IT platforms and termination of the service. This includes standardized interfaces and data portability mechanisms.
34e2d064d03382d71d655fca4221f76e84fdf2a2.remediation: Review and enhance portability and interoperability capabilities.
34e2d064d03382d71d655fca4221f76e84fdf2a2.evidence_required: Interface documentation and data export procedures

34e2d064d03382d71d655fca4221f76e84fdf2a2.title: Procurement Development and Maintenance
34e2d064d03382d71d655fca4221f76e84fdf2a2.description: The cloud provider complies with the security targets in case of new developments and procurement of information systems as well as changes. Security requirements must be integrated into the development lifecycle and procurement processes.
34e2d064d03382d71d655fca4221f76e84fdf2a2.remediation: Implement security requirements in procurement and development processes.
34e2d064d03382d71d655fca4221f76e84fdf2a2.evidence_required: Procurement documentation and security requirement specifications

34e2d064d03382d71d655fca4221f76e84fdf2a2.title: Service Provider and Supplier Control
34e2d064d03382d71d655fca4221f76e84fdf2a2.description: The cloud provider protects information that can be accessed by service providers and/or suppliers of the cloud provider (subcontractors) and monitors the services and security requirements agreed upon. This includes contractual security obligations and ongoing monitoring of subcontractor compliance.
34e2d064d03382d71d655fca4221f76e84fdf2a2.remediation: Review subcontractor agreements and implement monitoring controls.
34e2d064d03382d71d655fca4221f76e84fdf2a2.evidence_required: Subcontractor agreements and monitoring reports

34e2d064d03382d71d655fca4221f76e84fdf2a2.title: Security Incident Management
34e2d064d03382d71d655fca4221f76e84fdf2a2.description: The cloud provider assures a consistent and comprehensive approach regarding the monitoring, recording, assessment, communication and escalation of security incidents. Incident response procedures must be documented and regularly tested.
34e2d064d03382d71d655fca4221f76e84fdf2a2.remediation: Review incident response procedures and ensure timely escalation.
34e2d064d03382d71d655fca4221f76e84fdf2a2.evidence_required: Incident logs and response procedure documentation

34e2d064d03382d71d655fca4221f76e84fdf2a2.title: Business Continuity Management
34e2d064d03382d71d655fca4221f76e84fdf2a2.description: The cloud provider establishes strategic governance of business continuity management (BCM). This includes planning, implementing and testing business continuity concepts as well as incorporating safeguards in order to ensure and maintain continuous operations.
34e2d064d03382d71d655fca4221f76e84fdf2a2.remediation: Review and test business continuity plans regularly.
34e2d064d03382d71d655fca4221f76e84fdf2a2.evidence_required: Business continuity plans and test results

34e2d064d03382d71d655fca4221f76e84fdf2a2.title: Security Check and Verification
34e2d064d03382d71d655fca4221f76e84fdf2a2.description: The cloud provider checks and verifies that the information security safeguards are implemented and carried out in accordance with the organisation-wide policies and instructions. Regular audits and assessments must be conducted.
34e2d064d03382d71d655fca4221f76e84fdf2a2.remediation: Conduct regular security audits and verify control implementation.
34e2d064d03382d71d655fca4221f76e84fdf2a2.evidence_required: Audit reports and verification records

34e2d064d03382d71d655fca4221f76e84fdf2a2.title: Compliance and Data Protection
34e2d064d03382d71d655fca4221f76e84fdf2a2.description: The cloud provider prevents violations against statutory or contractual duties with respect to information security. This includes compliance with data protection regulations, contractual obligations, and applicable legal requirements.
34e2d064d03382d71d655fca4221f76e84fdf2a2.remediation: Review compliance status and address any violations.
34e2d064d03382d71d655fca4221f76e84fdf2a2.evidence_required: Compliance assessments and legal documentation

34e2d064d03382d71d655fca4221f76e84fdf2a2.title: Mobile Device Management
34e2d064d03382d71d655fca4221f76e84fdf2a2.description: The cloud provider guarantees secure access to IT systems via mobile devices in the cloud provider's responsibility to develop and operate the cloud service. This includes mobile device security policies, encryption, and remote management capabilities.
34e2d064d03382d71d655fca4221f76e84fdf2a2.remediation: Implement mobile device management controls.
34e2d064d03382d71d655fca4221f76e84fdf2a2.evidence_required: Mobile device management policy and configuration records

34e2d064d03382d71d655fca4221f76e84fdf2a2.title: Incident Management and Exception Handling
34e2d064d03382d71d655fca4221f76e84fdf2a2.description: The cloud provider must establish regulations for handling significant incidents and conditions that constitute exceptions to regular operations, such as the failure of critical IT systems. These procedures must define the escalation path, communication requirements, and remediation steps for both the cloud provider and cloud customer.
34e2d064d03382d71d655fca4221f76e84fdf2a2.remediation: Review incident response procedures and ensure all significant incidents are properly documented and handled.
34e2d064d03382d71d655fca4221f76e84fdf2a2.evidence_required: Incident logs, escalation records, and exception handling procedures

34e2d064d03382d71d655fca4221f76e84fdf2a2.title: Subcontractor Management
34e2d064d03382d71d655fca4221f76e84fdf2a2.description: The cloud provider must identify and document all functions assigned or outsourced to subcontractors. The system description must include the type and scope of outsourced functions and controls implemented at subcontractors, using either the inclusive method (including subcontractor controls) or the carve-out method (excluding subcontractor controls from scope).
34e2d064d03382d71d655fca4221f76e84fdf2a2.remediation: Maintain comprehensive subcontractor inventory and assess their control environments.
34e2d064d03382d71d655fca4221f76e84fdf2a2.evidence_required: Subcontractor register, service agreements, and control assessment reports

34e2d064d03382d71d655fca4221f76e84fdf2a2.title: System Description for Type 2 Reporting
34e2d064d03382d71d655fca4221f76e84fdf2a2.description: For type 2 reporting, the system description must represent all essential changes to the internal control system related to cloud services made during the period covered, in a sufficiently detailed manner. This includes changes resulting from C5 updates. Information relevant to the internal control system environment must not be omitted or distorted.
34e2d064d03382d71d655fca4221f76e84fdf2a2.remediation: Ensure system description accurately reflects all material changes during the reporting period.
34e2d064d03382d71d655fca4221f76e84fdf2a2.evidence_required: Change logs, system description updates, and period coverage documentation

34e2d064d03382d71d655fca4221f76e84fdf2a2.title: Future Remediation Planning and Implementation Dates
34e2d064d03382d71d655fca4221f76e84fdf2a2.description: The audit report must specify the measures planned for future elimination of deficiencies, including the target completion date when these measures will be effectively implemented. This ensures accountability and follow-through on remediation actions.
34e2d064d03382d71d655fca4221f76e84fdf2a2.remediation: Establish a remediation tracking system with milestone dates and implementation deadlines.
34e2d064d03382d71d655fca4221f76e84fdf2a2.evidence_required: Remediation plans with target dates and implementation status reports

34e2d064d03382d71d655fca4221f76e84fdf2a2.title: Auditor Liability Reporting Requirements
34e2d064d03382d71d655fca4221f76e84fdf2a2.description: Specifications regarding the type and limit of the auditor's liability to the service provider and other report recipients must be included in the audit report. This information is important for report recipients and must be included according to the agreement, while may vary based on country-specific regulations.
