34e2d064d03382d71d655fca4221f76e84fdf2a2.remediation: Ensure liability specifications are documented in the audit engagement agreement and included in the final report.
34e2d064d03382d71d655fca4221f76e84fdf2a2.evidence_required: Liability clause in engagement agreement and audit report

34e2d064d03382d71d655fca4221f76e84fdf2a2.title: Disclosure and Investigatory Powers Transparency
34e2d064d03382d71d655fca4221f76e84fdf2a2.description: The cloud provider must provide comprehensible and transparent specifications in service level agreements, process documentation, or comparable documentation regarding applicable disclosure and investigatory powers of government agencies that allow access to cloud customer data. These specifications must enable an expert third party to assess the general suitability of the cloud service for the customer application. If the cloud provider accesses third-party services, the provider must obtain these specifications from them.
34e2d064d03382d71d655fca4221f76e84fdf2a2.remediation: Ensure all disclosure and investigatory power specifications are documented and accessible to customers.
34e2d064d03382d71d655fca4221f76e84fdf2a2.evidence_required: Service level agreements, process documentation, or comparable documentation containing disclosure specifications

34e2d064d03382d71d655fca4221f76e84fdf2a2.title: Certifications and Independent Third-Party Certificates
34e2d064d03382d71d655fca4221f76e84fdf2a2.description: The cloud provider must provide comprehensible and transparent specifications in service level agreements, process documentation, or comparable documentation regarding available and valid certifications and certificates of independent third parties. These specifications must enable an expert third party to assess the general suitability of the cloud service for the customer application. Acceptable certifications include ISO/IEC 27001, ISO 22301, proof of compliance with data protection accepted by responsible data protection authorities, audit reports according to ISAE 3402/SSAE 16/SOC 1/IDW PS 951, and software certificates according to IDW PS 880. The target of certification and/or the corresponding scope for system certifications is important.
34e2d064d03382d71d655fca4221f76e84fdf2a2.remediation: Maintain current certifications and ensure certification scope covers customer-relevant systems.
34e2d064d03382d71d655fca4221f76e84fdf2a2.evidence_required: Service level agreements, process documentation, or comparable documentation listing valid certifications and their scope

34e2d064d03382d71d655fca4221f76e84fdf2a2.title: Information Security Management System (ISMS)
34e2d064d03382d71d655fca4221f76e84fdf2a2.description: The top management initiates, controls and monitors an information security management system (ISMS) which is based on ISO standards of the 2700x series. The instruments and methods used allow a comprehensible control of the following tasks and activities to permanently maintain and ensure information security: Planning, implementing the plan and/or carrying out the project; Performance review and/or monitoring the achievement of objectives; Eliminating discovered flaws and weaknesses and continuous improvement. The ISMS also includes the IT processes for the development and operation of the cloud service.
34e2d064d03382d71d655fca4221f76e84fdf2a2.remediation: Implement a formal ISMS with documented policies, procedures, and controls aligned with ISO 27001 standards.
34e2d064d03382d71d655fca4221f76e84fdf2a2.evidence_required: ISMS documentation, top management approval records, certification evidence

34e2d064d03382d71d655fca4221f76e84fdf2a2.title: Strategic Information Security Targets and Top Management Responsibility
34e2d064d03382d71d655fca4221f76e84fdf2a2.description: Strategic targets regarding information security and responsibility of the top management must be defined and documented as part of the ISMS framework.
34e2d064d03382d71d655fca4221f76e84fdf2a2.remediation: Define strategic information security objectives and assign clear accountability to top management.
34e2d064d03382d71d655fca4221f76e84fdf2a2.evidence_required: Strategic security targets documentation, RACI matrix for security responsibilities

34e2d064d03382d71d655fca4221f76e84fdf2a2.title: Risk Identification, Analysis, Assessment and Handling
34e2d064d03382d71d655fca4221f76e84fdf2a2.description: The organization must identify, analyze, assess, and handle information security risks through a systematic risk management process.
34e2d064d03382d71d655fca4221f76e84fdf2a2.remediation: Conduct comprehensive risk assessments and implement risk treatment plans.
34e2d064d03382d71d655fca4221f76e84fdf2a2.evidence_required: Risk assessment reports, risk treatment plans, risk register

34e2d064d03382d71d655fca4221f76e84fdf2a2.title: Security Policies
34e2d064d03382d71d655fca4221f76e84fdf2a2.description: The organization must establish, implement, and maintain information security policies and instructions.
34e2d064d03382d71d655fca4221f76e84fdf2a2.remediation: Develop and approve comprehensive security policies covering all relevant domains.
34e2d064d03382d71d655fca4221f76e84fdf2a2.evidence_required: Security policy documents, approval records, review logs

34e2d064d03382d71d655fca4221f76e84fdf2a2.title: Security Instructions
34e2d064d03382d71d655fca4221f76e84fdf2a2.description: The organization must develop detailed security instructions to implement the security policies effectively.
34e2d064d03382d71d655fca4221f76e84fdf2a2.remediation: Create detailed security instructions aligned with security policies.
34e2d064d03382d71d655fca4221f76e84fdf2a2.evidence_required: Security instruction documents, distribution records

34e2d064d03382d71d655fca4221f76e84fdf2a2.title: Security Policy and Instruction Maintenance
34e2d064d03382d71d655fca4221f76e84fdf2a2.description: Security policies and instructions must be regularly reviewed and updated to ensure continued relevance and effectiveness.
34e2d064d03382d71d655fca4221f76e84fdf2a2.remediation: Establish a policy review cycle and ensure timely updates to security documentation.
34e2d064d03382d71d655fca4221f76e84fdf2a2.evidence_required: Policy review records, version control documentation

34e2d064d03382d71d655fca4221f76e84fdf2a2.title: Top Management Notification
34e2d064d03382d71d655fca4221f76e84fdf2a2.description: The top management must be notified of significant information security events, risks, and compliance status.
34e2d064d03382d71d655fca4221f76e84fdf2a2.remediation: Implement a formal reporting mechanism to ensure top management receives timely security updates.
34e2d064d03382d71d655fca4221f76e84fdf2a2.evidence_required: Notification records, escalation procedures, management reporting

34e2d064d03382d71d655fca4221f76e84fdf2a2.title: Authorities and Responsibilities in the Framework of Information Security
34e2d064d03382d71d655fca4221f76e84fdf2a2.description: Responsibilities shared between the cloud provider and cloud customers, duties to cooperate as well as interfaces for the reporting of security incidents and malfunctions are defined and documented.
34e2d064d03382d71d655fca4221f76e84fdf2a2.remediation: Define and document the responsibilities between cloud provider and cloud customers, establish cooperation duties, and create clear interfaces for reporting security incidents and malfunctions.
34e2d064d03382d71d655fca4221f76e84fdf2a2.evidence_required: Documented responsibility matrix, incident reporting procedures, cooperation agreements

34e2d064d03382d71d655fca4221f76e84fdf2a2.title: Separation of Duties
34e2d064d03382d71d655fca4221f76e84fdf2a2.description: Operative and controlling functions should not be performed by one and the same person at the same time. If it is not possible to achieve a separation of duties for organisational or technical reasons, appropriate compensating controls are established in order to prevent or uncover improper activities. The cloud provider has documented any function separation conflicts and the compensating controls established for this purpose comprehensively in a role and rights concept to allow for an assessment of the appropriateness and effectiveness of these controls.
34e2d064d03382d71d655fca4221f76e84fdf2a2.remediation: Review role assignments and implement compensating controls where separation of duties cannot be achieved.
34e2d064d03382d71d655fca4221f76e84fdf2a2.evidence_required: Role and rights concept documentation, segregation of duties matrix, compensating controls documentation

34e2d064d03382d71d655fca4221f76e84fdf2a2.title: Contact with Relevant Government Agencies and Interest Groups
34e2d064d03382d71d655fca4221f76e84fdf2a2.description: Appropriate and relevant contacts of the cloud provider with government agencies and interest groups are established to be always informed about current threat scenarios and countermeasures. Relevant contacts include Federal Office for Information Security (BSI), OWASP Foundation, CERT alliances DFN-CERT, TF-CSIRT, and comparable agencies. Procedures are defined and documented to communicate the information received to internal and external employees of the cloud provider and to be able to respond to it appropriately and in a timely manner.
34e2d064d03382d71d655fca4221f76e84fdf2a2.remediation: Establish and maintain contacts with relevant government agencies and interest groups, document procedures for threat intelligence dissemination.
34e2d064d03382d71d655fca4221f76e84fdf2a2.evidence_required: Contact directory, communication procedures, threat intelligence distribution records

34e2d064d03382d71d655fca4221f76e84fdf2a2.title: Background Verification and Employment Screening
34e2d064d03382d71d655fca4221f76e84fdf2a2.description: The cloud provider verifies the curriculum vitae, academic titles, and degrees of all employees. For sensitive posts in the company, a police clearance certificate is required. The security check can be supported by a specialised service provider. If employees of a service provider have access to user data, the service provider must meet this requirement and make it transparent according to DLL-01 and DLL-02. Special approval procedures in the hiring process for employees and posts for which particularly sensitive information is accessed are established.
34e2d064d03382d71d655fca4221f76e84fdf2a2.remediation: Implement comprehensive background verification process for all employees, especially for sensitive positions.
34e2d064d03382d71d655fca4221f76e84fdf2a2.evidence_required: Background verification records, police clearance certificates, CV verification documents

34e2d064d03382d71d655fca4221f76e84fdf2a2.title: Employment Agreements with Security Obligations
34e2d064d03382d71d655fca4221f76e84fdf2a2.description: Employment agreements include the obligations of the cloud provider's internal and external employees to comply with relevant laws, regulations, and provisions regarding information security (see KOS-10). The security policy as well as the policies and instructions for information security derived from this are added to the employment agreement documents. Corresponding compliance is confirmed by the employee by a written statement before they can access the data of the cloud customers or the (shared) IT infrastructure.
34e2d064d03382d71d655fca4221f76e84fdf2a2.remediation: Ensure all employees sign security obligations in employment agreements before gaining access to customer data or IT infrastructure.
34e2d064d03382d71d655fca4221f76e84fdf2a2.evidence_required: Signed employment agreements, security policy acknowledgments, written statements of compliance

34e2d064d03382d71d655fca4221f76e84fdf2a2.title: Security Training and Awareness Programme
34e2d064d03382d71d655fca4221f76e84fdf2a2.description: A security training and awareness-raising programme tailored to specific target groups on the topic of information security is available and mandatory for all internal and external employees of the cloud provider. The programme is updated at regular intervals with respect to the applicable policies and instructions, the assigned roles and responsibilities as well as the known threats and must then be run through again. The programme includes at least regular and documented instruction on the secure configuration and secure operation.
34e2d064d03382d71d655fca4221f76e84fdf2a2.remediation: Implement mandatory security training programme for all employees with regular updates and documentation.
34e2d064d03382d71d655fca4221f76e84fdf2a2.evidence_required: Training records, programme content, completion certificates, update logs

34e2d064d03382d71d655fca4221f76e84fdf2a2.title: Third-Party Security Awareness Requirements
34e2d064d03382d71d655fca4221f76e84fdf2a2.description: External service providers and suppliers of the cloud provider, who contribute to the development or operation of the cloud service, are obliged by contract to make their employees and subcontractors aware of the specific security requirements of the cloud provider and train their employees generally in the subject of information security. The cloud provider checks on a random basis that the service providers and suppliers have carried out the instruction in an appropriate manner.
34e2d064d03382d71d655fca4221f76e84fdf2a2.remediation: Include security requirements in third-party contracts and conduct periodic audits of third-party training compliance.
34e2d064d03382d71d655fca4221f76e84fdf2a2.evidence_required: Third-party contracts, training records, and audit reports

34e2d064d03382d71d655fca4221f76e84fdf2a2.title: Asset Inventory
34e2d064d03382d71d655fca4221f76e84fdf2a2.description: The assets (e.g., PCs, peripheral devices, telephones, network components, servers, installation documentation, process instructions, IT applications, tools) used to render the cloud service are identified and inventoried. By means of appropriate processes and safeguards, it is ensured that this inventory remains complete, correct, up-to-date and consistent. A history of the changes to the entries in the inventory is kept in a comprehensible manner. If no effective automatic procedures are established for this, this is ensured by a manual review of the inventory data of the assets which takes place at least once a month. In the event of a failure of assets which are of essential importance for the availability of the cloud service (e.g., central network components), the cloud provider is able to promptly detect which cloud customers are affected by this in order to ensure a response to the malfunctions occurred that complies with the service level agreement. By means of technical safeguards, it is ensured that the inventory of the assets is updated automatically at regular intervals.
34e2d064d03382d71d655fca4221f76e84fdf2a2.remediation: Implement automated asset inventory tracking and ensure monthly manual reviews if automation is not available.
34e2d064d03382d71d655fca4221f76e84fdf2a2.evidence_required: Asset inventory records, change history logs, monthly review documentation

34e2d064d03382d71d655fca4221f76e84fdf2a2.title: Assignment of Persons Responsible for Assets
34e2d064d03382d71d655fca4221f76e84fdf2a2.description: All inventoried assets are assigned to a person responsible on the part of the cloud provider. The persons responsible of the cloud provider are responsible over the entire life cycle of the assets, ensuring that information security remain valid even if the area of responsibility changes or the employment relationship is terminated.
34e2d064d03382d71d655fca4221f76e84fdf2a2.remediation: Assign responsible persons to all assets and ensure handover procedures are in place for role changes.
34e2d064d03382d71d655fca4221f76e84fdf2a2.evidence_required: Asset responsibility assignment records, lifecycle management documentation

34e2d064d03382d71d655fca4221f76e84fdf2a2.title: Instruction Manuals for Assets
34e2d064d03382d71d655fca4221f76e84fdf2a2.description: Policies and instructions with technical and organisational safeguards for the proper handling of assets are documented, communicated and provided according to SA-01 in the respectively current version.
34e2d064d03382d71d655fca4221f76e84fdf2a2.remediation: Ensure all asset policies and instructions are documented, current, and communicated to relevant personnel.
34e2d064d03382d71d655fca4221f76e84fdf2a2.evidence_required: Current asset policies, instruction manuals, and evidence of distribution

34e2d064d03382d71d655fca4221f76e84fdf2a2.title: Handing In and Returning Assets
34e2d064d03382d71d655fca4221f76e84fdf2a2.description: All internal and external employees of the cloud provider are obliged to return or irrevocably delete all assets which were handed over to them in relation to the cloud service and/or for which they are responsible as soon as the employment relationship has been terminated.
34e2d064d03382d71d655fca4221f76e84fdf2a2.remediation: Implement formal asset return and deletion procedures upon employment termination.
34e2d064d03382d71d655fca4221f76e84fdf2a2.evidence_required: Asset return/deletion records, termination checklists

34e2d064d03382d71d655fca4221f76e84fdf2a2.title: Classification of Information
34e2d064d03382d71d655fca4221f76e84fdf2a2.description: The cloud provider uses a uniform classification of information and assets which are relevant to the development and rendering of the cloud service. The classification should take into consideration: criticality for the rendering of the cloud service, sensitivity to unauthorised disclosure or modification, data type, applicable legislation of the assets, geographical location, context, legal restrictions, contractual restrictions, and value.
34e2d064d03382d71d655fca4221f76e84fdf2a2.remediation: Implement a uniform classification scheme for all information and assets relevant to the cloud service.
34e2d064d03382d71d655fca4221f76e84fdf2a2.evidence_required: Classification scheme documentation, asset classification records

34e2d064d03382d71d655fca4221f76e84fdf2a2.title: Labelling of Information and Handling of Assets
34e2d064d03382d71d655fca4221f76e84fdf2a2.description: Work instructions and processes for the implemented classification scheme of information and assets are in place in order to ensure the labeling of information as well as the corresponding handling of assets. This only refers to assets which store or process information. The labeling of information must be carried out after the classification has been performed and is usually the responsibility of the asset owners.
34e2d064d03382d71d655fca4221f76e84fdf2a2.remediation: Implement work instructions for labeling information and handling assets according to the classification scheme.
34e2d064d03382d71d655fca4221f76e84fdf2a2.evidence_required: Labeling procedures, asset handling guidelines, evidence of labeling implementation

34e2d064d03382d71d655fca4221f76e84fdf2a2.title: Management of Data Media
34e2d064d03382d71d655fca4221f76e84fdf2a2.description: Policies and instructions with technical and organisational safeguards for the secure handling of data media of any type are documented, communicated and provided according to SA-01. The targets establish a reference to the classification of information (see AM-05). They include the secure use, the secure transport as well as the irrevocable deletion and destruction of data media. Policies should address secure and irrevocable deletion of data and disposal/destruction of data media, encryption of removable media, and transmission of data to new data media when a medium is replaced.
34e2d064d03382d71d655fca4221f76e84fdf2a2.remediation: Implement and enforce data media handling policies including encryption, secure transport, and certified destruction procedures.
34e2d064d03382d71d655fca4221f76e84fdf2a2.evidence_required: Data media handling policies, disposal logs, encryption records

34e2d064d03382d71d655fca4221f76e84fdf2a2.title: Transfer and Removal of Assets
34e2d064d03382d71d655fca4221f76e84fdf2a2.description: Devices, hardware, software or data may only be transferred to external premises after it has been approved by authorised committees or bodies of the cloud provider. The transfer takes place securely according to the type of the assets to be transferred.
34e2d064d03382d71d655fca4221f76e84fdf2a2.remediation: Establish an asset transfer approval process and ensure all transfers to external premises are authorized and documented.
34e2d064d03382d71d655fca4221f76e84fdf2a2.evidence_required: Asset transfer request forms, approval records, transfer logs

34e2d064d03382d71d655fca4221f76e84fdf2a2.title: Perimeter Protection
34e2d064d03382d71d655fca4221f76e84fdf2a2.description: The perimeter of premises or buildings which house sensitive or critical information, information systems or other network infrastructure are protected in a physically solid manner and by means of appropriate security safeguards that conform to the current state of the art.
34e2d064d03382d71d655fca4221f76e84fdf2a2.remediation: Implement physical security controls at facility perimeters including barriers, access controls, and surveillance systems.
34e2d064d03382d71d655fca4221f76e84fdf2a2.evidence_required: Physical security assessments, perimeter security documentation, access control logs

34e2d064d03382d71d655fca4221f76e84fdf2a2.title: Temperature Resilience Specifications
34e2d064d03382d71d655fca4221f76e84fdf2a2.description: The cloud provider should determine and communicate which external temperatures the air conditioning of the computer centre can withstand for how long (e.g., 30°C/14 days, 35°C/6 days, 40°C/4 days). If river water is used for cooling, it should be specified at which water levels the air conditioning can be maintained for how long.
34e2d064d03382d71d655fca4221f76e84fdf2a2.remediation: Document and communicate temperature resilience specifications for all cooling systems including water-based cooling.
34e2d064d03382d71d655fca4221f76e84fdf2a2.evidence_required: Temperature tolerance documentation, cooling system specifications

34e2d064d03382d71d655fca4221f76e84fdf2a2.title: Supply Line Protection and Visual Inspection
34e2d064d03382d71d655fca4221f76e84fdf2a2.description: To demonstrate resilience against interception and protection against damage, wiring diagrams and a corresponding protection concept can be submitted, which is checked for plausibility in discussion with the person responsible. During visual inspection, attention should be paid to traces of violent opening attempts at closed distributors, currency of the documentation inside the distributors, conformity of the actual wiring and patches with documentation.
34e2d064d03382d71d655fca4221f76e84fdf2a2.remediation: Maintain current wiring diagrams, conduct regular visual inspections of distribution panels, verify patch and wiring consistency with documentation.
34e2d064d03382d71d655fca4221f76e84fdf2a2.evidence_required: Wiring diagrams, protection concept documentation, visual inspection reports

34e2d064d03382d71d655fca4221f76e84fdf2a2.title: Maintenance of Infrastructure and Devices
34e2d064d03382d71d655fca4221f76e84fdf2a2.description: Policies and instructions with technical and organisational safeguards are documented, communicated and provided according to SA-01 which describe the maintenance (especially remote maintenance), deletion, updating and re-use of assets in information processing in outsourced premises or by external personnel. Policies should address secure deletion of sensitive data prior to external repair or maintenance, analyses of assets prior to re-use to avoid manipulations or malfunctions, and renewal of assets if availability, security, integrity or confidentiality could be at risk.
34e2d064d03382d71d655fca4221f76e84fdf2a2.remediation: Document and implement maintenance policies covering remote maintenance, deletion, updating and re-use of assets. Ensure secure deletion procedures before external maintenance and asset analysis before re-use.
34e2d064d03382d71d655fca4221f76e84fdf2a2.evidence_required: Maintenance policies, asset inventory records, secure deletion logs

34e2d064d03382d71d655fca4221f76e84fdf2a2.title: Capacity Management – Data Location
34e2d064d03382d71d655fca4221f76e84fdf2a2.description: The cloud customer is able to determine the locations (city/country) of the data processing and storage including data backups. This requirement supplements requirement UP-02 in which the locations are to be documented. If a cloud provider renders their services at several sites, this requirement demands the cloud provider to define precisely at which site the service is rendered and the data processed.
34e2d064d03382d71d655fca4221f76e84fdf2a2.remediation: Verify that data location information is accurately documented and accessible to the cloud customer through the self-service portal.
34e2d064d03382d71d655fca4221f76e84fdf2a2.evidence_required: Data location documentation and self-service portal records

34e2d064d03382d71d655fca4221f76e84fdf2a2.title: Capacity Management – Control of Resources
34e2d064d03382d71d655fca4221f76e84fdf2a2.description: In case of IaaS/PaaS, the cloud customer is able to control and monitor the distribution of the system resources assigned to them for administration/use (e.g. computing capacity or storage capacity) in order to prevent resources from being congested.
34e2d064d03382d71d655fca4221f76e84fdf2a2.remediation: Implement resource monitoring dashboards and alerting mechanisms to prevent resource congestion.
34e2d064d03382d71d655fca4221f76e84fdf2a2.evidence_required: Resource monitoring reports and capacity utilization logs

34e2d064d03382d71d655fca4221f76e84fdf2a2.title: Protection Against Malware
34e2d064d03382d71d655fca4221f76e84fdf2a2.description: The logical and physical IT systems which the cloud provider uses for the development and rendering of the cloud service as well as the network perimeters which are subject to the cloud provider's area of responsibility are equipped with anti-virus protection and repair programs which allow for a signature- and behaviour-based detection and removal of malware. The programs are updated according to the contractual agreements concluded with the manufacturer(s), but at least once a day. The cloud provider draws up regular reports on the performed audits, which are reviewed and analysed by authorised bodies or committees.
34e2d064d03382d71d655fca4221f76e84fdf2a2.remediation: Ensure all systems have up-to-date anti-virus protection with signature and behavior-based detection capabilities. Verify daily update cycles are maintained.
34e2d064d03382d71d655fca4221f76e84fdf2a2.evidence_required: Anti-virus configuration records, update logs, and audit reports

34e2d064d03382d71d655fca4221f76e84fdf2a2.title: Management Console Security Configuration
34e2d064d03382d71d655fca4221f76e84fdf2a2.description: Policies and instructions describe the technical safeguards for the secure configuration and monitoring of the management console (both the self-service of the customer and the cloud administration of the service provider) in order to protect them against malware. The update is performed with the highest frequency that is contractually offered by the manufacturer(s).
34e2d064d03382d71d655fca4221f76e84fdf2a2.remediation: Verify that management console security configurations are in place and malware protection updates are applied according to manufacturer schedules.
34e2d064d03382d71d655fca4221f76e84fdf2a2.evidence_required: Security configuration policies, malware protection documentation, update logs

34e2d064d03382d71d655fca4221f76e84fdf2a2.title: Data Backup and Restoration Concept
34e2d064d03382d71d655fca4221f76e84fdf2a2.description: Policies and instructions with technical and organisational safeguards in order to avoid losing data are documented, communicated and provided according to SA-01. They provide reliable procedures for the regular backup (backup as well as snapshots, where applicable) and restoration of data. The scope, frequency and duration of the retention comply with the contractual agreements concluded with the cloud customers as well as the cloud provider's business requirements. Access to the data backed up is limited to authorised personnel. Restoration procedures include control mechanisms that ensure that restorations are carried out only after they have been approved by persons authorised to do so according to the contractual agreements with the cloud customers or the internal policies of the cloud provider.
34e2d064d03382d71d655fca4221f76e84fdf2a2.remediation: Review backup and restoration procedures to ensure they comply with contractual agreements and include proper approval controls.
34e2d064d03382d71d655fca4221f76e84fdf2a2.evidence_required: Backup policies, restoration procedures, backup logs, approval records

34e2d064d03382d71d655fca4221f76e84fdf2a2.title: Backup vs Snapshot Distinction
34e2d064d03382d71d655fca4221f76e84fdf2a2.description: When making data backups, a distinction must be made between backups and snapshots of virtual machines. Snapshots do not replace backups, but can be part of the backup strategy in order to achieve the recovery point objectives (RPO) provided that they are stored additionally outside the original data location. The business requirements of the cloud provider for the scope, frequency and duration of the data backup are derived from the business impact analysis (see control BCM-03) for development and operating processes of the cloud service.
34e2d064d03382d71d655fca4221f76e84fdf2a2.remediation: Ensure snapshots are stored separately from original data locations and are supplemented by proper backups to meet RPO requirements.
34e2d064d03382d71d655fca4221f76e84fdf2a2.evidence_required: Backup strategy documentation, snapshot storage locations, RPO compliance evidence

34e2d064d03382d71d655fca4221f76e84fdf2a2.title: Data Backup and Restoration - Monitoring
34e2d064d03382d71d655fca4221f76e84fdf2a2.description: The process of backing up data is monitored by means of technical and organisational safeguards. Malfunctions are examined and eliminated promptly by qualified employees in order to ensure compliance with the contractual duties towards the cloud customers or the cloud provider's business requirements with respect to the scope, frequency and duration of the retention.
34e2d064d03382d71d655fca4221f76e84fdf2a2.remediation: Review backup monitoring logs and investigate any malfunctions identified.
34e2d064d03382d71d655fca4221f76e84fdf2a2.evidence_required: Backup monitoring logs, malfunction reports, and remediation records

34e2d064d03382d71d655fca4221f76e84fdf2a2.title: Data Backup and Restoration - Regular Tests
34e2d064d03382d71d655fca4221f76e84fdf2a2.description: Backup media and restoration procedures must be tested with dedicated test media by qualified employees at regular intervals. The tests are designed in such a way that the reliability of the backup media and the restoration time can be audited with sufficient certainty. The tests are carried out by qualified employees and the results documented comprehensibly. Any occurring errors are eliminated in a timely manner.
34e2d064d03382d71d655fca4221f76e84fdf2a2.remediation: Review restoration test results and address any failures identified.
34e2d064d03382d71d655fca4221f76e84fdf2a2.evidence_required: Backup restoration test records, test media usage logs, and error resolution documentation

34e2d064d03382d71d655fca4221f76e84fdf2a2.title: Data Access Authorisation Requirements
34e2d064d03382d71d655fca4221f76e84fdf2a2.description: Organisational and/or technical safeguards ensure that granted access authorisations meet the following requirements: Data access authorisations comply with the 'least-privilege principle'; when granting data access authorisations, only access authorisations necessary to perform the corresponding tasks should be granted ('need-to-know principle'); formal approval is given by an authorised person before the data access authorisations are set up (i.e. before the user can access data of the cloud customers or components of the shared IT infrastructure); technically assigned data access authorisations do not exceed the formal approval.
34e2d064d03382d71d655fca4221f76e84fdf2a2.remediation: Review all access authorisations to ensure they comply with least-privilege and need-to-know principles, and verify that technical assignments do not exceed formal approvals.
34e2d064d03382d71d655fca4221f76e84fdf2a2.evidence_required: Access authorization records, approval documentation, least-privilege and need-to-know policy documentation

34e2d064d03382d71d655fca4221f76e84fdf2a2.title: Withdrawal of Authorisations (De-provisioning)
34e2d064d03382d71d655fca4221f76e84fdf2a2.description: Data access authorisations of users under the cloud provider's responsibility (internal and external employees) are withdrawn in the case of changes to the employment relationship (dismissal, transfer, longer period of absence/sabbatical/parental leave) promptly, but 30 days after its coming into force at the latest and/or suspended temporarily. Any access is deactivated completely as soon as the employment relationship has expired.
34e2d064d03382d71d655fca4221f76e84fdf2a2.condition: employment_status == 'terminated' and days_since_termination <= 30 and access_active == false
34e2d064d03382d71d655fca4221f76e84fdf2a2.remediation: Immediately review all terminated or transferred employee accounts and ensure access is revoked within 30 days of employment change.
34e2d064d03382d71d655fca4221f76e84fdf2a2.evidence_required: Employment change records, access revocation logs, de-provisioning timestamps

34e2d064d03382d71d655fca4221f76e84fdf2a2.title: Regular Review of Data Access Authorisations
34e2d064d03382d71d655fca4221f76e84fdf2a2.description: Data access authorisations of users under the cloud provider's responsibility (internal and external employees) are reviewed at least once a year in order to adjust them promptly to changes to the employment relationship (dismissal, transfer, longer period of absence/sabbatical/parental leave). The review is performed by persons authorised to do so from corresponding departments.
34e2d064d03382d71d655fca4221f76e84fdf2a2.remediation: Conduct annual access reviews for all users and ensure timely adjustments based on employment relationship changes.
34e2d064d03382d71d655fca4221f76e84fdf2a2.evidence_required: Annual access review reports, reviewer authorization records, review completion dates

34e2d064d03382d71d655fca4221f76e84fdf2a2.title: Administrator Authorizations
34e2d064d03382d71d655fca4221f76e84fdf2a2.description: Granting and change of data access authorisations for internal and external users with administrative or extensive authorisations under the responsibility of the cloud provider comply with the policy or the management of system and data access authorisations (see IDM-01) or a separate policy. The authorisations are granted in a personalised manner and as is necessary for performing the corresponding tasks (need-to-know principle). Organisational and/or technical safeguards make sure that granting these authorisations does not result in undesired, critical combinations which violate the principle of the separation of duties (e.g. assigning authorisations for the administration of both the database and the operating system). If this is not possible in certain selected cases, appropriate, compensating controls are established in order to identify any misuse of these authorisations (e.g. logging and monitoring by an SIEM solution).
34e2d064d03382d71d655fca4221f76e84fdf2a2.remediation: Implement separation of duties controls or compensating controls such as SIEM logging and monitoring for critical authorization combinations.
34e2d064d03382d71d655fca4221f76e84fdf2a2.evidence_required: Authorization policy documents, role definitions, separation of duties matrix, SIEM logs

34e2d064d03382d71d655fca4221f76e84fdf2a2.title: Non-Disclosure of Authentication Information
34e2d064d03382d71d655fca4221f76e84fdf2a2.description: Secret authentication credentials (e.g. passwords, certificates, security token) is assigned to internal and external users of the cloud provider or cloud customer, provided that this is subject to organisational or technical procedures of the cloud provider, in a proper organised procedure which ensures the confidentiality of the information. If it is assigned initially, it is valid only temporarily, but not longer than 14 days. Moreover, users are required to maintain confidentiality of their authentication credentials.
34e2d064d03382d71d655fca4221f76e84fdf2a2.remediation: Implement secure credential assignment procedures with maximum 14-day initial validity and enforce confidentiality requirements.
34e2d064d03382d71d655fca4221f76e84fdf2a2.evidence_required: Credential management policy, password issuance records, user acknowledgment forms

34e2d064d03382d71d655fca4221f76e84fdf2a2.title: Secure Login Methods
34e2d064d03382d71d655fca4221f76e84fdf2a2.description: The confidentiality of the login information of internal and external users under the cloud provider's responsibility is protected by the following safeguards: identity check by trusted procedures, use of recognised industry standards for authentication and authorisation (e.g., multi-factor authentication, no use of jointly used authentication information, automatic expiry), and multi-factor authentication for administrators of the cloud provider (e.g., using a smart card or biometric characteristics) is absolutely necessary.
34e2d064d03382d71d655fca4221f76e84fdf2a2.remediation: Implement multi-factor authentication for all cloud provider administrators and enforce industry standard authentication methods.
34e2d064d03382d71d655fca4221f76e84fdf2a2.evidence_required: MFA implementation documentation and authentication policy records

34e2d064d03382d71d655fca4221f76e84fdf2a2.title: Handling of Emergency Users
34e2d064d03382d71d655fca4221f76e84fdf2a2.description: The use of emergency users (for activities which cannot be carried out with personalised, administrative users) is documented, to be justified and requires the approval by an authorised person, which takes the principle of the separation of functions into account. The emergency user is only activated as long as it is necessary to perform the corresponding tasks. At least once a month, the activations of the emergency users are reviewed.
34e2d064d03382d71d655fca4221f76e84fdf2a2.remediation: Implement formal approval workflow for emergency user activations and conduct monthly reviews of all emergency user activity.
34e2d064d03382d71d655fca4221f76e84fdf2a2.evidence_required: Emergency user activation logs, approval records, and monthly review reports

34e2d064d03382d71d655fca4221f76e84fdf2a2.title: Automatic Authentication Security Controls
34e2d064d03382d71d655fca4221f76e84fdf2a2.description: The system implements automatic controls including: lockout of 15 minutes after 5 failed login attempts with increasing wait times per failed attempt; prevention of multiple concurrent sessions for the same user; automatic lock after 15 minutes of inactivity; minimum password length of 14 characters for privileged users and 8 characters for users without wide-ranging authorizations; password complexity requirements including uppercase letters, lowercase letters, special characters, and numbers; mandatory password change after 90 days with next login; and password history of 12.
34e2d064d03382d71d655fca4221f76e84fdf2a2.remediation: Review and enforce all automatic authentication security controls as specified in the policy.
34e2d064d03382d71d655fca4221f76e84fdf2a2.evidence_required: Authentication logs, password policy configuration, lockout configuration records

34e2d064d03382d71d655fca4221f76e84fdf2a2.title: Restriction and Control of Administrative Software
34e2d064d03382d71d655fca4221f76e84fdf2a2.description: The use of service programs and management consoles (e.g., for the management of the hypervisor or virtual machines), which allow extensive access to the data of cloud customers, is restricted to authorized persons. Granting and changes to corresponding data access authorizations comply with the policy for the management of system and data access authorizations. Access is controlled by means of strong authentication techniques, including multi-factor authentication (see K OS-06).
34e2d064d03382d71d655fca4221f76e84fdf2a2.remediation: Review administrative access permissions and ensure only authorized persons have access to service programs and management consoles.
34e2d064d03382d71d655fca4221f76e84fdf2a2.evidence_required: Authorization records, administrative access logs, MFA configuration

34e2d064d03382d71d655fca4221f76e84fdf2a2.title: Control of Access to Source Code
34e2d064d03382d71d655fca4221f76e84fdf2a2.description: Access to the source code and supplementary information that is relevant to the development of the cloud service (e.g., architecture documentation, test plans) is granted restrictively and monitored in order to prevent unauthorized functions from being introduced and unintended changes from being made.
34e2d064d03382d71d655fca4221f76e84fdf2a2.remediation: Review source code access permissions and implement monitoring for all access to source code repositories.
34e2d064d03382d71d655fca4221f76e84fdf2a2.evidence_required: Source code access logs, authorization records, access monitoring reports

34e2d064d03382d71d655fca4221f76e84fdf2a2.title: Logical Network Segmentation
34e2d064d03382d71d655fca4221f76e84fdf2a2.description: The provider implements logical segmentation between cloud customers on the network level to guarantee the confidentiality and integrity of data transmitted. The segregation of stored and processed data must be ensured. If the appropriateness and effectiveness of the logical segmentation cannot be assessed with sufficient certainty (e.g., due to a complex implementation), evidence can also be demonstrated by audit results of expert third parties (e.g., penetration tests for the validation of the concept).
34e2d064d03382d71d655fca4221f76e84fdf2a2.remediation: Implement and verify logical network segmentation between tenants. Conduct penetration testing if segmentation effectiveness cannot be otherwise assessed.
34e2d064d03382d71d655fca4221f76e84fdf2a2.evidence_required: Network segmentation diagrams, penetration test reports, tenant isolation verification

34e2d064d03382d71d655fca4221f76e84fdf2a2.title: Session ID Security for SaaS Web Applications
34e2d064d03382d71d655fca4221f76e84fdf2a2.description: For the secure segmentation of jointly used resources for web applications which are provided as SaaS, the session ID in the basic level should: be generated randomly and have an adequate entropy of at least 128 Bit (16 characters) in order to withstand educated guessing of the session ID (for example, by means of a brute-force attack); be adequately protected for transmission and client-side storage; have limited validity (timeout) which is as short as possible, measured by the requirements for the use of the web application. Upon successful authentication or change from an insecure communication channel (HTTP), a secure communication channel (HTTPS) should be switched to.
34e2d064d03382d71d655fca4221f76e84fdf2a2.condition: session.id.entropy >= 128 and session.timeout <= configured_max and request.scheme == 'HTTPS' after auth
34e2d064d03382d71d655fca4221f76e84fdf2a2.remediation: Implement cryptographically secure session IDs with minimum 128-bit entropy, enforce HTTPS, and configure minimal session timeouts.
34e2d064d03382d71d655fca4221f76e84fdf2a2.evidence_required: Session management configuration, code review of session ID generation, HTTPS enforcement verification

34e2d064d03382d71d655fca4221f76e84fdf2a2.title: Network Topology Documentation
34e2d064d03382d71d655fca4221f76e84fdf2a2.description: The architecture of the network is documented comprehensibly and currently (e.g., in the form of diagrams) in order to avoid errors in the management and operation of the network infrastructure.
34e2d064d03382d71d655fca4221f76e84fdf2a2.remediation: Create and maintain current network topology documentation including diagrams and architectural specifications.
34e2d064d03382d71d655fca4221f76e84fdf2a2.evidence_required: Network topology diagrams, documentation update logs, architecture documentation

34e2d064d03382d71d655fca4221f76e84fdf2a2.title: Secure Separation for IaaS/PaaS
34e2d064d03382d71d655fca4221f76e84fdf2a2.description: In the case of IaaS/PaaS, the secure separation is ensured by physically separated networks or by means of strongly encrypted VLANs. The requirements for higher protection requirements can be used as guidance in the basic level.
34e2d064d03382d71d655fca4221f76e84fdf2a2.condition: exists(network.isolation) and (network.physical_separation == true or network.vlan.encryption >= required_level)
34e2d064d03382d71d655fca4221f76e84fdf2a2.remediation: Implement physical network separation or strongly encrypted VLANs for IaaS/PaaS tenant isolation.
34e2d064d03382d71d655fca4221f76e84fdf2a2.evidence_required: Network architecture documentation, VLAN configuration, isolation verification reports

34e2d064d03382d71d655fca4221f76e84fdf2a2.title: Policies for Data Transmission
34e2d064d03382d71d655fca4221f76e84fdf2a2.description: Policies and instructions with technical and organisational safeguards in order to protect the transmission of data against unauthorised interception, manipulation, copying, modification, redirection or destruction (e.g. use of encryption) are documented, communicated and provided according to SA-01. The policy and instructions establish a reference to the classification of information (see AM-05).
34e2d064d03382d71d655fca4221f76e84fdf2a2.remediation: Develop and implement comprehensive data transmission policies with encryption requirements and classification references.
34e2d064d03382d71d655fca4221f76e84fdf2a2.evidence_required: Data transmission policy documentation and encryption implementation records

34e2d064d03382d71d655fca4221f76e84fdf2a2.title: Confidentiality Agreement
34e2d064d03382d71d655fca4221f76e84fdf2a2.description: The non-disclosure or confidentiality agreements to be concluded with internal employees, external service providers and suppliers of the cloud provider are based on the requirements of the cloud provider in order to protect confidential data and business details. The requirements must be identified, documented and reviewed at regular intervals (at least once a year). If the review shows that the requirements have to be adjusted, new non-disclosure or confidentiality agreements are concluded. The agreements must be signed prior to the start of the contract relationship and/or before access to data of the cloud users is granted.
34e2d064d03382d71d655fca4221f76e84fdf2a2.condition: exists(agreement.nda) and agreement.signed == true and agreement.review_date <= now()
34e2d064d03382d71d655fca4221f76e84fdf2a2.remediation: Ensure all employees, service providers and suppliers have signed NDAs before gaining access to data and conduct annual reviews.
34e2d064d03382d71d655fca4221f76e84fdf2a2.evidence_required: Signed NDA/confidentiality agreements and annual review records

34e2d064d03382d71d655fca4221f76e84fdf2a2.title: Secure Data Import and Export
34e2d064d03382d71d655fca4221f76e84fdf2a2.description: The cloud provider uses secure network protocols for the import and export of information as well as for the management of the service in order to ensure the integrity, confidentiality and availability of the transported data.
34e2d064d03382d71d655fca4221f76e84fdf2a2.remediation: Implement secure network protocols (e.g., TLS, SSH) for all data import/export operations and service management communications.
34e2d064d03382d71d655fca4221f76e84fdf2a2.evidence_required: Network protocol documentation, encryption configuration records

34e2d064d03382d71d655fca4221f76e84fdf2a2.title: Secure Deletion of Data
34e2d064d03382d71d655fca4221f76e84fdf2a2.description: Both when changing the storage media for maintenance purposes and upon request of the cloud customer or the termination of the contract relationship, the content data of the cloud customer, including the data backups and the meta data (as soon as they are no longer required for the proper documentation of the accounting and billing), is deleted completely. The methods used for this (e.g. by overwriting data several times, deletion of the key) prevent the data from being restored via forensic methods.
34e2d064d03382d71d655fca4221f76e84fdf2a2.remediation: Implement secure data deletion procedures including cryptographic erasure and multi-pass overwrite methods. Ensure deletion certificates are obtained and retained.
34e2d064d03382d71d655fca4221f76e84fdf2a2.evidence_required: Data deletion logs, media sanitization certificates, deletion confirmation records

34e2d064d03382d71d655fca4221f76e84fdf2a2.title: Policies for Development and Procurement of Information Systems
34e2d064d03382d71d655fca4221f76e84fdf2a2.description: Policies and instructions with technical and organisational safeguards for the proper development and/or procurement of information systems for the development or operation of the cloud service, including middleware, databases, operating systems and network components are documented, communicated and provided according to SA-01. The policies and instructions describe at least the following aspects: Security in software development methods.
34e2d064d03382d71d655fca4221f76e84fdf2a2.remediation: Develop and document comprehensive policies for the development and procurement of information systems incorporating security requirements.
34e2d064d03382d71d655fca4221f76e84fdf2a2.evidence_required: Development/procurement policies, security requirements documentation, SA-01 distribution records

34e2d064d03382d71d655fca4221f76e84fdf2a2.title: Outsourcing of Development Security Requirements
34e2d064d03382d71d655fca4221f76e84fdf2a2.description: If the development of the cloud service (or parts thereof) is outsourced regarding the design, development, test and/or provision of source code of the cloud service, a high level of security is required. At minimum, the following aspects must be agreed upon contractually between the cloud provider and external service providers: requirements for a secure software development process (especially design, development and testing), provision of evidence demonstrating that adequate testing was carried out by the external service provider, acceptance test of the quality of the services rendered according to the functional and non-functional requirements agreed upon, and the right to subject the development process and controls to testing, also on a random basis.
34e2d064d03382d71d655fca4221f76e84fdf2a2.remediation: Review outsourcing contracts to ensure all security requirements are documented and contractually binding.
34e2d064d03382d71d655fca4221f76e84fdf2a2.evidence_required: Outsourcing contracts, secure development requirements documentation, testing evidence records

34e2d064d03382d71d655fca4221f76e84fdf2a2.title: Policies for Changes to Information Systems
34e2d064d03382d71d655fca4221f76e84fdf2a2.description: Policies and instructions with technical and organisational safeguards for the proper management of changes to information systems for the development or operation of the cloud service.
34e2d064d03382d71d655fca4221f76e84fdf2a2.remediation: Establish formal change management policies with technical and organisational safeguards.
34e2d064d03382d71d655fca4221f76e84fdf2a2.evidence_required: Change management policy documentation, change request procedures

34e2d064d03382d71d655fca4221f76e84fdf2a2.title: Programming Language Security Policies
34e2d064d03382d71d655fca4221f76e84fdf2a2.description: Programming policies must be established for each programming language used, addressing security considerations such as buffer overflow prevention, hiding internal object references towards users, and other language-specific security vulnerabilities.
34e2d064d03382d71d655fca4221f76e84fdf2a2.remediation: Develop and enforce programming security policies for all used languages.
34e2d064d03382d71d655fca4221f76e84fdf2a2.evidence_required: Programming language security policies, code review guidelines

34e2d064d03382d71d655fca4221f76e84fdf2a2.title: Security in Version Control
34e2d064d03382d71d655fca4221f76e84fdf2a2.description: Security controls must be implemented for version control systems to protect source code integrity, prevent unauthorized modifications, and ensure proper tracking of all changes to the codebase.
34e2d064d03382d71d655fca4221f76e84fdf2a2.remediation: Implement access controls and audit logging for version control systems.
34e2d064d03382d71d655fca4221f76e84fdf2a2.evidence_required: Version control access policies, audit logs, change tracking records

34e2d064d03382d71d655fca4221f76e84fdf2a2.title: Adherence to Industry Security Standards
34e2d064d03382d71d655fca4221f76e84fdf2a2.description: The cloud provider shall comply with security standards established in the industry, such as OWASP for web applications, to ensure application security best practices are followed throughout the development lifecycle.
34e2d064d03382d71d655fca4221f76e84fdf2a2.remediation: Review application security against OWASP Top 10 and industry standards.
34e2d064d03382d71d655fca4221f76e84fdf2a2.evidence_required: Security standards compliance documentation, OWASP alignment evidence

34e2d064d03382d71d655fca4221f76e84fdf2a2.title: Common Criteria Certification for Procured Products
34e2d064d03382d71d655fca4221f76e84fdf2a2.description: For procurement of products used in the cloud service, products certified according to the Common Criteria for Information Technology Security Evaluation (CC) at evaluation level EAL 4 are preferred. If uncertified products are procured although certified products are available, this must be documented and justified.
34e2d064d03382d71d655fca4221f76e84fdf2a2.condition: exists(procurement.certification) and (procurement.cc_certified == true or procurement.justification exists)
34e2d064d03382d71d655fca4221f76e84fdf2a2.remediation: Prefer CC EAL 4 certified products; document justification for any uncertified alternatives.
34e2d064d03382d71d655fca4221f76e84fdf2a2.evidence_required: Product certification records, procurement justification documentation

34e2d064d03382d71d655fca4221f76e84fdf2a2.title: System Landscape Separation
34e2d064d03382d71d655fca4221f76e84fdf2a2.description: Production environments are separated physically or logically by non-production environments in order to avoid unauthorised access or changes to the production data. Production data is not replicated in test or development environments in order to maintain their confidentiality.
34e2d064d03382d71d655fca4221f76e84fdf2a2.remediation: Implement logical or physical separation between production and non-production environments. Ensure production data is not copied to test or development systems.
34e2d064d03382d71d655fca4221f76e84fdf2a2.evidence_required: Environment architecture documentation, network segmentation diagrams, data classification policies

34e2d064d03382d71d655fca4221f76e84fdf2a2.title: Separation of Functions in Change Management
34e2d064d03382d71d655fca4221f76e84fdf2a2.description: Change management procedures include role-based authorisations in order to ensure an appropriate separation of duties regarding the development, release and migration of changes between the environments.
34e2d064d03382d71d655fca4221f76e84fdf2a2.remediation: Implement role-based access controls in change management workflow. Ensure different individuals handle development, release, and migration functions.
34e2d064d03382d71d655fca4221f76e84fdf2a2.evidence_required: Change management procedures, role definitions, authorization matrices

34e2d064d03382d71d655fca4221f76e84fdf2a2.title: Service Provider and Supplier Security Policies
34e2d064d03382d71d655fca4221f76e84fdf2a2.description: Policies and instructions for ensuring the protection of information accessed by other third parties (e.g. service providers and/or suppliers of the cloud provider), who contribute significant parts to the development or operation of the cloud service, are documented, communicated and provided according to SA-01. The corresponding controls are used to mitigate risks which may result from the potential access to information of the cloud customers. The following aspects are at least to be taken into account: Definition and description of minimum security requirements with regard to the information processed, which are based on recognised industry standards such as ISO/IEC 27001, and legal and regulatory requirements.
34e2d064d03382d71d655fca4221f76e84fdf2a2.remediation: Develop and implement comprehensive policies for service provider and supplier security. Define minimum security requirements based on ISO/IEC 27001 and applicable legal requirements.
34e2d064d03382d71d655fca4221f76e84fdf2a2.evidence_required: Service provider security policies, supplier contracts, security requirements documentation, ISO/IEC 27001 alignment evidence

34e2d064d03382d71d655fca4221f76e84fdf2a2.title: Monitoring of Service Providers and Suppliers
34e2d064d03382d71d655fca4221f76e84fdf2a2.description: Procedures for the regular monitoring and review of agreed services and security requirements of third parties (e.g., service providers and/or suppliers of the cloud provider) who contribute essential parts to the development or operation of the cloud service are established. The safeguards include at least the following aspects: regular review of service reports (e.g., SLA), monitoring of security requirements, and verification of subcontractor compliance.
34e2d064d03382d71d655fca4221f76e84fdf2a2.remediation: Establish formal third-party monitoring program with documented review cycles and evidence collection.
34e2d064d03382d71d655fca4221f76e84fdf2a2.evidence_required: Third-party review records, SLA monitoring reports, audit reports

34e2d064d03382d71d655fca4221f76e84fdf2a2.title: Handling of Metadata
34e2d064d03382d71d655fca4221f76e84fdf2a2.description: Requirements for data protection, intellectual property rights, copyright, and handling of metadata, including description of how they are ensured (e.g., site of data processing and liability, see surrounding parameters for transparency).
34e2d064d03382d71d655fca4221f76e84fdf2a2.remediation: Implement metadata handling policies and verify compliance with data protection requirements.
34e2d064d03382d71d655fca4221f76e84fdf2a2.evidence_required: Metadata handling policies, data processing location documentation, privacy impact assessments

34e2d064d03382d71d655fca4221f76e84fdf2a2.title: Subcontractor Security Obligations
34e2d064d03382d71d655fca4221f76e84fdf2a2.description: Disclosure and contractual obligation to the minimum security requirements also to sub-contractors if they do not only contribute insignificant parts to the development or operation of the cloud service (e.g., service provider of the computing centre). Subcontractors are contractually obliged to grant the cloud provider auditing rights regarding the effectiveness of the service-related internal control system as well as with respect to the compliance of the security requirements agreed upon.
34e2d064d03382d71d655fca4221f76e84fdf2a2.remediation: Review and update subcontractor agreements to ensure audit rights and security requirements are contractually mandated.
34e2d064d03382d71d655fca4221f76e84fdf2a2.evidence_required: Subcontractor contracts, audit rights documentation, security requirement flow-down records

34e2d064d03382d71d655fca4221f76e84fdf2a2.title: Subcontractor Evidence via Independent Certifications
34e2d064d03382d71d655fca4221f76e84fdf2a2.description: Subcontractors can demonstrate evidence of compliance by submitting corresponding certificates of independent third parties (e.g., in the form of reports according to ISAE 3402/IDW PS 951). This also includes subcontractors of the subcontractor.
34e2d064d03382d71d655fca4221f76e84fdf2a2.remediation: Collect and verify third-party certifications from all significant subcontractors.
34e2d064d03382d71d655fca4221f76e84fdf2a2.evidence_required: Third-party audit reports, SOC reports, certification documents

34e2d064d03382d71d655fca4221f76e84fdf2a2.title: Responsibilities and Procedural Model for Security Incident Management
34e2d064d03382d71d655fca4221f76e84fdf2a2.description: Policies and instructions with technical and organisational safeguards are documented, communicated and provided according to SA-01 in order to ensure a fast, effective and proper response to all known security incidents.
34e2d064d03382d71d655fca4221f76e84fdf2a2.remediation: Ensure all security incidents are documented and responded to according to established policies and procedures.
34e2d064d03382d71d655fca4221f76e84fdf2a2.evidence_required: Documented security incident management policies and procedures

34e2d064d03382d71d655fca4221f76e84fdf2a2.title: Classification of Customer Systems
34e2d064d03382d71d655fca4221f76e84fdf2a2.description: All customer systems are classified according to the agreements (SLA) between the cloud provider and cloud customer regarding the criticality for the rendering of services. The assignment of classifications is reviewed regularly as well as after essential changes/events for all customer systems. Deviations are followed up and eliminated in a timely manner. Moreover, the classification shows which parameters regarding the recovery of a system were agreed upon with the cloud customer.
34e2d064d03382d71d655fca4221f76e84fdf2a2.remediation: Review and update system classifications according to SLA agreements and criticality requirements.
34e2d064d03382d71d655fca4221f76e84fdf2a2.evidence_required: System classification records, SLA agreements, review logs

34e2d064d03382d71d655fca4221f76e84fdf2a2.title: Processing of Security Incidents
34e2d064d03382d71d655fca4221f76e84fdf2a2.description: Events which could represent a security incident are classified, prioritised and subjected to a cause analysis by qualified personnel of the cloud provider or in connection with external security service providers. The cloud provider must have at least the roles listed in OIS-03 filled, requirements for the classification, prioritisation and escalation of security incidents defined, and interfaces with the incident management and the business continuity management created.
34e2d064d03382d71d655fca4221f76e84fdf2a2.remediation: Ensure all security incidents are properly classified, prioritised, and analyzed by qualified personnel.
34e2d064d03382d71d655fca4221f76e84fdf2a2.evidence_required: Incident classification records, priority assignments, cause analysis reports

34e2d064d03382d71d655fca4221f76e84fdf2a2.title: Documentation and Reporting of Security Incidents
34e2d064d03382d71d655fca4221f76e84fdf2a2.description: The cloud provider has established a computer emergency response team (CERT) which contributes to the coordinated solution of specific security incidents. Customers affected by security incidents are informed in a timely manner and appropriate form. Instructions are given as to how data of a suspicious system can be collected in the event of a security incident so that it can be used as evidence. Moreover, there are analysis plans for typical security incidents as well as an evaluation method so that the information collected will not lose its evidentiary value during a subsequent legal appraisal.
34e2d064d03382d71d655fca4221f76e84fdf2a2.remediation: Establish CERT, implement incident notification procedures, and maintain evidence collection chain.
34e2d064d03382d71d655fca4221f76e84fdf2a2.evidence_required: CERT establishment records, incident notification logs, evidence collection procedures, analysis plans
